Legit Security.description:
Description
About Legit Security
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in software security — how to make AI-first organizations release applications securely, leveraging AI agents to create secure code from the start, and fix vulnerabilities automatically. In a world where attackers leverage AI to exploit software in minutes, this becomes a must-have capability for every organization.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who doesn't just manage- they lead, own, and win. Someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp strategic thinking, and who knows how to turn customer pain into product that matters.
What you'll own
Take full ownership of product domains, from strategy to feature definition to delivery, driving growth and ensuring impactful results.
Engage directly with customers to deeply understand their needs and pain points and translate to actionable tasks
Define product features, backlogs, and roadmaps, collaborating closely with UX, design, and R&D with the power to build some of it yourself.
Communicate effectively and create alignment across sales, marketing, customer success, support, and R&D.
Requirements
What you’ll bring
A high-performing leader who owns their domain and gets things done
3–4 years of experience as a software developer or engineering team lead — experience in both is a significant advantage.
2–3 years of proven product management experience, particularly with enterprise B2B products.
Strong software engineering or DevOps background.
“Builder” mindset – come to build the product with us. Leverage AI to bypass blockers and lead with example.
Fluent English with outstanding communication and presentation skills.
Core product skills we value
Leader / Founder mindset
Hungry to win- energetic and pushing with ambition to make things happen
Strategic and first principal thinking
Presentation skills

Lema AI.description:
Description
We are
Lema AI is a fast-growing, venture-backed B2B SaaS company on a mission to ensure modern businesses never fail because of a third-party incident. We’re reimagining the stagnant Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and cyber resilience space by moving companies from reactive compliance to proactive, real-time risk prevention powered by advanced AI.
Already trusted by industry-leading enterprises, Lema is entering a phase of hypergrowth. We’re tripling our team as we build a category-defining platform, guided by a culture of radical ownership, transparency, and fast, cross-functional execution. If you thrive in high-context, high-impact environments, you’ll feel at home here.
More about Lema:
Lema.ai website
Business Insider - Cybersecurity startup Lema has come out of stealth to raise $24 million
Team8 - Why We Invested In Lema
About the TPRM market:
McKinsey - nearly one-third of recent cyber breaches originated from third parties
Hitch Partners - Third-party risk dominates security priorities, with AI-enhanced attacks and cloud misconfigurations completing the top three concerns.
About The Role
We’re looking for a a senior backend engineer with 6+ years of experience, playing a key role in building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up. As part of the company’s early engineering team, you’ll help shape both the product and the engineering culture, own backend architecture, lead end-to-end feature development, and drive technical excellence while collaborating closely with product, design, and infrastructure in a fast-growing environment.
What You’ll Do
Be one of our first 10 engineers, shaping both our product and our engineering culture.
Define and evolve the backend architecture, infrastructure and development best practices for a fast-growing team.
Own features end-to-end - from concept and design discussions to implementation, deployment and observability.
Solve complex challenges in distributed systems, event-driven architectures and real-time data pipelines.
Continuously improve developer workflows - identify friction, integrate new tools, automate repetitive tasks and champion engineering excellence.
Lead and mentor a small team of engineers: drive planning, break down work, ensure quality delivery and help hire exceptional talent.
Collaborate with experienced peers - engineers, PMs and designers - who’ve built large-scale systems at top-tier companies.
Here are some of the technologies we work with: Golang, Python, Protobuf, React, Typescript, Kafka, Postgresql, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS
Requirements
What You Bring
A seasoned backend engineer (6+ years) who thrives on building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up.
Experienced in designing and scaling modern microservices architectures (both BE and FE integration).
Capable of taking complex features from design to deployment, owning every stage of the backend lifecycle - while guiding others to do the same.
Pragmatic about code quality: confident refactoring, simplifying and deleting code when needed.
Comfortable leading code reviews, defining engineering standards and collaborating across product, design and infrastructure.
Why Join Lema AI
Impact: Build a category-defining platform that safeguards how modern businesses operate.
Ownership: Join a culture that gives you full context, autonomy, and trust to drive outcomes.
Compensation & Benefits: Competitive salary, equity package, and additional perks
Velocity: Work with exceptional peers in a high-energy, low-bureaucracy environment.
Growth: Shape a company that’s scaling rapidly, backed by Tier 1 investors and visionary customers.
Lema AI.title: Senior Backend Engineer

Lightbits Labs.description:
In this role, you will work at the intersection of CUDA, GPU architecture, transformer inference, Rust systems programming, and large-scale AI serving platforms. You will design and build systems that intelligently manage KV cache placement across GPU, CPU, storage, and remote memory tiers while maximizing throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing infrastructure costs. This is a highly hands-on position for someone who enjoys solving deep performance challenges, optimizing every layer of the inference stack, and turning low-level innovations into customer-facing product value. Position based in Israel.
Responsibilities
Design and implement KV cache offloading, streaming, and memory management infrastructure for large-scale LLM serving.
Build cache-aware scheduling systems that determine when to keep, evict, prefetch, stream, compress, decompress, or recompute KV cache blocks.
Optimize inference runtimes such as vLLM and SGLang, including paged attention, prefix caching, schedulers, and cache management systems.
Develop mechanisms that overlap IO operations with attention execution to maximize GPU utilization and minimize latency.
Build high-performance components in Rust, C++, and CUDA for scheduling, cache coordination, telemetry, and inference optimization.
Profile and eliminate bottlenecks across GPU, CPU, memory, networking, storage, and runtime layers.
Design benchmark frameworks and performance tests for long-context, streaming, multi-turn, and high-concurrency workloads.
Measure and improve key inference metrics including TTFT, TBT/ITL, GPU utilization, cache hit rates, and cost per token.
Collaborate closely with Product, Platform, ML, and Engineering teams to deliver production-ready optimization capabilities.
Desired Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with CUDA programming and GPU performance optimization.
Deep understanding of transformer inference, attention mechanisms, KV cache architecture, batching, streaming generation, prefill, and decode.
Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or similar LLM serving frameworks.
Experience designing or optimizing KV cache systems, including cache reuse, eviction, prefix caching, radix caching, or cache offloading.
Strong systems programming skills in Rust, C++, or both.
Strong Python skills for experimentation, benchmarking, and performance analysis.
Experience building performance-sensitive schedulers, async IO systems, or distributed infrastructure.
Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as Nsight, CUDA profiling tools, or custom telemetry systems.
Experience with GPUDirect, RDMA, NVMe, cache compression, FlashAttention, paged attention, or distributed inference architectures is a strong advantage.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Linearb.description:
Responsibilities:
Deep technical resolution
Own the hardest tickets end to end: reproducing bugs, reading logs and production data, debugging integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Jira and CI systems, and finding workarounds when there isn't yet a fix.
Act as the subject matter expert across the LinearB UI and backend, with independent access to our database and logging tools.
Escalate genuine defects to engineering with a clean reproduction and a clear ask, and stay accountable for the customer outcome through to resolution.
Automation and deflection
Own how we reduce ticket volume and effort, and decide what that should look like. We would rather hire someone with their own view than someone executing ours.
Automate triage, severity classification and routing so that whoever picks up a ticket starts from a sorted queue.
Work with our Product documentation owners to close the gap between what customers ask and what our docs answer. You will bring the evidence of what is missing and help prioritise it; they own the content.
Treat every repeat ticket as a defect in the system, whether the fix is an article, a macro, an automation, or a product change.
The queue itself
Work the queue. Until automation and coverage carry more of the load, first-line tickets are part of this job, and we would rather say so plainly than surprise you. Reducing that share over time is one of the things we will measure you on.
Set the standard for how we respond: clear, fast, and technically correct, on every tier of ticket.
Partnership with Customer Success
Work closely with our CSM leads on the grey area between a technical problem and a customer relationship. Some tickets are purely technical. Others are a signal that an account needs a different kind of attention, and the reverse is true too: some relationship conversations turn out to be a bug.
Judge, case by case and with the CSM, who should own a given customer conversation and when to bring the other person in. Getting this right matters more than drawing a clean line between the two functions, and there is no policy that will decide it for you.
Help CSMs and CSAs get better at the technical questions they can reasonably handle, and be honest with them about the ones they should hand over.
Coverage model and how the function grows
Design how support coverage actually works: which hours are staffed, by whom, and what happens outside them. You will propose the model, not inherit one.
Coordinate a rotation of technical contributors from our CSM and CSA teams who support the queue outside core hours. You will own the schedule and the handoffs.
Make the case for what the function needs next, whether that is another engineer, an outsourced first-line partner, or more automation. As we add capacity, you lead it.
Build per-account SLA instrumentation in Zendesk so that our response and resolution commitments are visible and measurable in real time, for every account that has them.
Own the operational side of our contractual support obligations, including the reporting some customers are entitled to.
Requirements:
5+ years in a technical support, solutions or site reliability role where you were the person others escalated to.
Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot and resolve complex issues at root cause, independently, without a queue of colleagues to lean on.
Mastery of SQL, logging and observability tools (Datadog, LogRocket or similar), REST APIs, and SSO and SCIM configuration.
Practical experience with Zendesk and Jira, and a point of view on how they should be configured rather than just how to use them.
Demonstrated experience reducing support load through automation or process. AI agents, deflection tooling, knowledge strategy, macro and trigger design, workflow automation, or something we have not thought of. Tell us what you built and what it changed.
Nice to have: comfort reading and debugging code. Python, Node.js, TypeScript and React are what you would encounter here. Formal people management experience is also nice to have.
A track record of working with Product and Engineering as a peer, bringing evidence rather than anecdote, and influencing what gets fixed.
Excellent written communication. Much of this job is explaining difficult technical situations clearly to senior people at large companies, in writing, under time pressure.
Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and git. Preferred.

תיאור המשרה
פיתוח ותחזוקה של מערכות ויישומים ארגוניים, תוך השתלבות בצוותי פיתוח שונים בהתאם לצורכי הארגון.
התפקיד הינו תפקיד פיתוח רוחבי, הכולל השתלבות במערכות ובצוותים שונים לצורך מילוי מקום ותגבור בתקופות שבהן נדרש מענה זמני לצוות.
העבודה כוללת למידה והיכרות עם מערכות קיימות ותהליכים עסקיים, פיתוח יכולות חדשות, תחזוקת קוד קיים, תיקון תקלות, עבודה עם בסיסי נתונים, ממשקים ושירותי API
התפקיד דורש יכולת למידה מהירה, הסתגלות לסביבות עבודה וטכנולוגיות שונות, עבודה בצוות ויכולת כניסה מהירה יחסית למערכת קיימת, תוך עבודה בהתאם לסטנדרטים ומתודולוגיות הפיתוח הנהוגים בארגון.
דרישות התפקיד:
· ידע והיכרות עם שפת C# וסביבת .NET
· היכרות עם עקרונות תכנות מונחה עצמים (OOP)
· היכרות עם פיתוח בסביבת Web
· ידע והיכרות עם בסיסי נתונים SQL ויכולת כתיבת שאילתות.
· היכרות עם עקרונות עבודה מול REST API ואינטגרציה בין מערכות.
· היכרות עם כלי ניהול קוד Git
· הבנה בסיסית בארכיטקטורת מערכות ובחלוקה לשכבות.
· יכולת קריאת קוד, הבנתו ואיתור תקלות בסיסי.
· יכולת למידה עצמאית ומהירה של מערכות, טכנולוגיות ותהליכים עסקיים.
· יכולת הסתגלות והשתלבות בצוותי פיתוח ובמערכות שונות בהתאם לצורכי הארגון.
· יכולת עבודה בצוות וקבלת הנחיה מקצועית.
· יכולת עבודה עצמאית לאחר תקופת למידה וחפיפה.
· יכולת תיעוד של קוד ושינויים שבוצעו.
יתרון:
· היכרות עם WinForms
· היכרות עם WCF
· היכרות עם תהליכי CI/CD
· היכרות עם סביבת ענן.

Design and secure cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP .
Lead cloud security, hardening, and modernization initiatives.

Secure containers, Kubernetes, serverless, and microservices environments.
Implement IaC and DevSecOps practices.
Drive cloud security monitoring, compliance, and risk reduction.
Partner with global technical and management teams.
Requirements
7+ years of hands-on cloud architecture/engineering experience.
Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, and GCP – required.
Strong experience in Cloud Security and cloud environment hardening .
Deep knowledge of IAM, networking, Zero Trust, Kubernetes, containers, and DevSecOps.
Experience with IaC, cloud governance, and security monitoring.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Excellent English – written and verbal.
Hybrid: 2 days from home.
Global role: Requires flexibility for occasional late working hours due to collaboration with US-based teams.

על התפקיד
אנחנו מחפשים מפתח/ת תוכנה מנוסה שיצטרף/תצטרף לצוות פיתוח מקצועי וייקח/תקח חלק בפיתוח מערכות מורכבות מקצה לקצה. התפקיד כולל פיתוח על פי מפרטים, הובלת רכיבים מרכזיים בפרויקט, ביצוע עבודות עיצוב ותכנות מורכבות, הנחיית מפתחים בצוות, תכנון וביצוע בדיקות סופיות ועבודה עם טכנולוגיות Frontend, Backend ותשתיות מתקדמות.
דרישות
• ניסיון של 4+ שנים בפיתוח תוכנה
• ניסיון מוכח בפיתוח Frontend עם HTML, CSS ו-JavaScript
• ניסיון בעבודה עם React, Angular או Vue.js
• ניסיון מוכח בפיתוח .NET Core או Java
• ניסיון בפיתוח Web API ושירותי רשת
• ניסיון בעבודה עם מסדי נתונים כגון SQL, PostgreSQL או MongoDB
• ניסיון בפיתוח והטמעת פתרונות Cloud , בדגש על Google Cloud
• יכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות, לצד הנחיה וליווי של מפתחים
היתרונות שלך
• ניסיון בעבודה עם עקרונות UI/UX Design
• ניסיון עם Docker , Kubernetes וטכנולוגיות קונטיינרים
• ניסיון בתכנון וביצוע בדיקות למערכות מורכבות
• ניסיון בהובלת רכיבי פיתוח מרכזיים ובהנחיית צוותי פיתוח
• היכרות מעמיקה עם סביבת פיתוח מודרנית ומתודולוגיות עבודה מתקדמות

MER Group.description:
Description
Account Manager – Africa (Native French Speaker)
MER Group is a global leader in Homeland Security, Intelligence, Communication and Smart Solutions, providing end-to-end projects worldwide.
We are looking for an experienced Account Manager to take full ownership of one of our strategic customers in Africa. This is a customer-facing role requiring a highly mature, service-oriented professional who will act as the primary interface between the customer and MER Group, ensuring the successful execution and ongoing operation of the project.
The role involves frequent travel to Africa (approximately every six weeks for two weeks at a time).
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer and build long-term trusted relationships.
Take full ownership of all customer activities at the site, ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
Coordinate and drive communication between the customer and internal teams, including Engineering, Operations, Logistics and Management.
Monitor project progress and ensure timely execution of customer requirements.
Prepare, review and translate technical and operational documents in French.
Lead meetings with customers and present project status, risks and action plans.
Support ongoing operational and technical activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify issues proactively and coordinate effective solutions with internal stakeholders.
Maintain clear documentation and reporting for both the customer and management.
Travel regularly to customer sites in Africa to support ongoing activities and strengthen customer relationships.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree – Mandatory.
Native-level French (spoken and written) – Mandatory.
Excellent ability to write, translate and prepare professional documents in French.
Proven experience managing strategic customer accounts, large-scale projects or customer operations.
Experience working with customers in Africa or extensive familiarity with African business environments – Strong advantage.
Experience in the Homeland Security, Defense, Intelligence, Communication or related industries – Strong advantage.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
High level of emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.

Animal health Technology Solutions offers global animal identification and monitoring solutions for companion animals and livestock. These solutions enable pet owners to better manage the health and well-being of their pets and enable livestock producers to improve well-being and animal production. Technology Solutions include Core Technologies in Livestock Identification, Dairy, Beef, and Swine monitoring, for which the product/market fit is established, as well as products in discovery.
Our Technology Solutions division is evolving. We are moving to a Product Operating Model – a new way of working that empowers product teams to take full ownership and accountability for delivering customer and business value in ways our customers love and that work for the business.
Our product and platform teams are cross-functional and durable, bringing together all the skills required to deliver impactful outcomes. Each team includes a Product Manager, Technology Lead, Product Designer, Delivery Lead, engineers, and developers.
We believe in customer centricity, ownership, and accountability. Solutions must be:
· Valuable – customers choose to buy or use them
· Viable – aligned with business constraints and goals
· Usable – intuitive and user-friendly
· Feasible – achievable with our technical capabilities
Leadership of the Product team is shared between the Product Manager and the Technology Lead, ensuring balanced guidance that bridges product vision and technical execution.

The responsibilities will include defining System, HW, Embedded, ATE, SW & Integration requirements as well as contributing to the design stage of each discipline, defining the protocol, technical problem solving, proof of concept and field testing and assisting in tests design and investigations.
The position requires multidisciplinary understanding, ability to quickly grasp new technological aspects as well as constraints , the capability to work in a multi-site matrix organization and working closely in a Product and Platform team with other system engineers, embedded software developers, HW engineers, Integration Engineers as well as backend and front-end teams.

· Experience with RF communication technologies (BLE, WiFi, LTE-M, LoRa, etc)
· Knowledge in backend systems and serverless solutions
· Working with Cloud based infrastructure for IoT devices

· Ability to focus on what's important.

· Strong desire for learning and innovation.
· “hands-on” approach.

· Good verbal & written communication Skills.

Description
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our R&D team and play a key role in building the company’s core technology from the ground up.
In this role, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of our backend systems - from architecture and technical design, through hands-on development, to production and scale. You’ll lead the creation of reliable, scalable foundations that bring Mami’s product vision to life.
At Mami, engineering goes far beyond writing code. You’ll work closely with every function in the company to design and build systems that solve meaningful business problems and directly impact the product and users.
What You'll Do
Build and lead complex, scalable backend systems that power our core web platform
Design and implement solid architectures with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability
Champion a "Full-cycle" engineering culture, owning everything from design to production-grade deployment
Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to ensure efficient, well-integrated systems across platforms
Continuously raise the bar on code quality, best practices, and engineering standards
Requirements
Proven track record in at least 2 technology companies, building and maintaining large-scale backend systems in production
Strong system design and architecture skills, with the ability to think several steps ahead
You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable being responsible for high-impact systems
Fast and independent learner who enjoys working with new technologies
Creative, out-of-the-box thinker, who likes to challenge engineering thoughtfully, and improve existing solutions
Nice to Have
Strong background in AWS and cloud-native architectures.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes.
Experience working with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Go (Golang) or strong interest in adopting it.
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.
Mami.title: Senior Backend Engineer

Description
We're looking for an enthusiastic Bookkeeper to join our Finance team and work closely with our Head Bookkeeper.
You will take ownership of the company's day-to-day bookkeeping operations, managing core accounting processes from end to end, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and supporting the monthly closing process.
This is a hands-on role with broad responsibility, ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, is highly organized, and excels at managing financial processes that support business growth.
📍Ramat HaHayal, Tel Aviv
🏠 Full-time position with an on-site work model
What you’ll do
Manage the full accounts payable process, including invoice processing, verification, and supplier payments
Manage accounts receivable, including invoicing, collections, and follow-up on outstanding balances
Perform bank, credit card, and supplier reconciliations, and record journal entries
Support the monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes
Assist the Head Bookkeeper with financial reporting and ongoing accounting activities
Work closely with employees, suppliers, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations
Requirements
Bookkeeping Level 3 certification
Hands-on experience with “Hashavshevet” - advantage
Strong Excel skills
Experience with Priority or SAP - advantage
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.
תיאור המשרה
﻿ (תיאור המשרה מנוסח בלשון נקבה, אך מיועד לכל המגדרים)
אנחנו מחפשים מנהלת חשבונות להצטרף למחלקת הכספים שלנו ולהיות שותפה מרכזית בניהול הפעילות הפיננסית של החברה.
בתפקיד הזה תעבדי בצמוד למנהלת חשבונות ראשית ותהי אחראית על הנהלת חשבונות שוטפת מקצה לקצה, תוך הקפדה על דיוק, סדר ותהליכי עבודה איכותיים.
זהו תפקיד עם אחריות רחבה, המתאים למי שנהנית לעבוד בסביבה דינמית, בעלת יכולות ארגון גבוהות, ויודעת להיות חלק מתהליכים פיננסיים התומכים בצמיחת החברה.
איך ייראה היום שלך אצלנו
ניהול תהליך הספקים מקצה לקצה, כולל קליטת חשבוניות, בדיקה וביצוע תשלומים
ניהול תהליך הלקוחות, כולל הפקת חשבוניות, מעקב אחר גבייה וטיפול ביתרות פתוחות
ביצוע התאמות בנקים, כרטיסי אשראי וספקים, ורישום פקודות יומן
תמיכה בתהליכי הסגירה החודשיים, הרבעוניים והשנתיים
עבודה צמודה עם מנהלת הכספים לצורך הכנת דוחות ופעילות חשבונאית שוטפת
עבודה שוטפת מול עובדים, ספקים וממשקים חיצוניים, להבטחת תהליכים פיננסיים יעילים ומדויקים
מה אנחנו אוהבים לראות
תעודת הנהלת חשבונות סוג 3 - חובה
ניסיון מעשי בעבודה עם ״חשבשבת״ - יתרון
שליטה גבוהה באקסל
ניסיון בעבודה עם פריוריטי או סאפ - יתרון
סדר, דיוק ויכולת ירידה לפרטים
יכולת עבודה עצמאית וניהול מספר משימות במקביל
יחסי אנוש מצוינים ויכולת עבודה בצוות
הסיפור שלנו
אנחנו סטארט-אפ בצמיחה מהירה, המבוסס על קהילה, אמון וחיבור אותנטי. מה שהתחיל כמועדון צרכנות קטן בהובלת מעיין אדם, הפך למותג צרכני מוביל עם למעלה מ-400,000 משתמשים פעילים. כיום החברה מתרחבת לפלטפורמה טכנולוגית שמעצימה יוצרים וקהילות לבנות חוויות קנייה אישיות משלהם, ומגדירה מחדש את הדרך שבה אנשים מתחברים, יוצרים וקונים אונליין.

Mami.description:
Description
We’re looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to lead Mami into its next chapter of growth. This role will own the company’s marketing strategy end-to-end, build a powerful consumer brand, scale growth channels, and drive meaningful demand across every touchpoint with our users and community.
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing market leader and shape Mami’s marketing vision from strategy to execution. You’ll develop bold, creative, and data-driven initiatives while driving performance across brand, content, design, performance marketing, and community.
Your main focus will be building a strong and iconic B2C brand in Israel, accelerating growth, scaling our community into a powerful engine, and positioning Mami as the leading B2C brand in the Israeli market.
What You’ll Do
Lead and Manage Mami’s Marketing team and strategy across brand, performance, content, CRM, Influencers, PR, and community.
Own and scale the full growth funnel- user acquisition, retention, activation, engagement, and monetization
Lead and develop internal marketing teams as well as external agencies, freelancers, and vendors.
Plan and manage marketing budgets, with hands-on ownership of measurement, optimization, and ROI-driven decision-making.
Conceptualize and execute creative campaigns and breakthrough brand initiatives.
Work closely with Product, Commerce, and Community teams to create a holistic and consistent user experience.
Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape to continuously refine strategy.
Lead product launches, seasonal campaigns, and strategic collaborations.
Requirements
Proven experience as a VP of Marketing/CMO or a senior Head of Marketing in a leading B2C company.
Strong track record in brand building, growth leadership, and managing large marketing budgets.
Deep hands-on experience in performance marketing (Meta, Google, TikTok), combined with a strong understanding of Brand & Content.
Experience with community-driven brands, influencers, UGC, and creator ecosystems - a significant advantage.
Sharp strategic thinking combined with strong execution and hands-on leadership.
Ability to lead teams, manage multiple stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Highly creative, proactive, organized, and capable of driving complex cross-functional processes.
Excellent interpersonal skills, collaborative mindset, and genuine passion for building meaningful brands and communities.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field - a strong advantage.
On-site availability with flexibility for meetings, launches, and field activities as needed.
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.
תיאור המשרה
אנחנו מחפשים סמנכ״ל/ית שיווק, להוביל את החברה לשלב הצמיחה הבא שלה. התפקיד כולל ניהול צוות השיווק, ואחריות מלאה על אסטרטגיית השיווק מקצה לקצה, בניית מותג צרכני חזק ועוצמתי, הרחבת ערוצי הצמיחה והנעת ביקוש משמעותי בכל נקודות המגע עם המשתמשות והקהילה שלנו.
זוהי הזדמנות ייחודית להצטרף לחברה מובילה בצמיחה מהירה, ולעצב את חזון השיווק שלנו, מהאסטרטגיה ועד לביצוע בפועל. במסגרת התפקיד תוביל/י מהלכים יצירתיים פורצי דרך ומבוססות דאטה, ותניע/י ביצועים בתחומי המותג, התוכן, העיצוב, והשיווק הביצועי (פרפורמנס).
הפוקוס המרכזי של התפקיד הוא בניית מותג חזק ואייקוני, הגדלת מעורבות הקהילה שלנו למנוע צמיחה משמעותי, ומיצוב החברה כמותג צרכני מוביל בשוק הישראלי.
איך ייראה היום שלך אצלנו
הובלה וניהול של צוות השיווק ואסטרטגיית השיווק בתחומי המותג, תוכן, משפיענים, יח״צ וקהילה, ושיווק ביצועי.
אחריות מלאה על משפך הצמיחה - רכישת משתמשים, שימור, אקטיבציה, מעורבות ומוניטיזציה.
הובלה ופיתוח של צוותי שיווק פנימיים לצד ניהול סוכנויות, פרילנסרים וספקים חיצוניים.
תכנון וניהול תקציבי שיווק, כולל אחריות להוצאה לפועל אופטימיזציה וקבלת החלטות מבוססות מדידה.
פיתוח והוצאה לפועל של קמפיינים קריאטיביים ומהלכי מיתוג פורצי דרך.
עבודה צמודה עם צוותי מוצר, מסחר וקהילה ליצירת חוויית משתמש הוליסטית, עקבית ואחידה.
ניתוח מגמות שוק, התנהגות צרכנים והסביבה התחרותית לצורך חידוד מתמיד של האסטרטגיה.
הובלת השקות מוצרים, קמפיינים עונתיים ושיתופי פעולה אסטרטגיים.
מה אנחנו אוהבים לראות
ניסיון מוכח כסמנכ״ל/ית שיווק, או במשרה דומה בכיר/ה בחברת צרכנות פרטית מובילה.
רקורד חזק בבניית מותגים, הובלת צמיחה וניהול תקציבי שיווק גדולים.
ניסיון בשיווק ביצועי (Meta, Google, TikTok), לצד הבנה חזקה במיתוג ותוכן.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מותגים מבוססי קהילה, משפיענים, יוזר ג׳נרטור קריאטור, ואקו סיסטם של יוצרים - יתרון משמעותי.
חשיבה אסטרטגית חדה בשילוב יכולות ביצוע גבוהות והובלה מעשית.
יכולת להוביל צוותים, לנהל ממשקים מרובים ולשגשג בסביבה דינמית ובצמיחה מהירה.
יצירתיות גבוהה, פרואקטיביות, סדר ויכולת להניע תהליכים מורכבים חוצי ארגון.
כישורים בינאישיים מצוינים, גישה שיתופית ותשוקה אמיתית לבניית מותגים וקהילות משמעותיים.
תואר ראשון או שני בשיווק, מנהל עסקים או תחום רלוונטי - יתרון משמעותי.
זמינות לעבודה מהמשרד, עם גמישות לפגישות, השקות ופעילות שטח לפי הצורך.
הסיפור שלנו
אנחנו סטארט-אפ בצמיחה מהירה, המבוסס על קהילה, אמון וחיבור אותנטי. מה שהתחיל כמועדון צרכנות קטן בהובלת מעיין אדם, הפך למותג צרכני מוביל עם למעלה מ־400,000 משתמשים פעילים. כיום החברה מתרחבת לפלטפורמה טכנולוגית שמעצימה יוצרים וקהילות לבנות חוויות קנייה אישיות משלהם, ומגדירה מחדש את הדרך שבה אנשים מתחברים, יוצרים וקונים אונליין.

Mami.description:
Description
We're looking for a Lifecycle & Marketing Automation Lead to join Mami's growth team and lead the design and execution of end-to-end customer journeys.
You'll bring our customer experience vision to life - creating personalized, multi-channel flows that drive engagement, retention, and revenue, while setting the standard for marketing excellence at Mami.
Your main focus will be Email, SMS, and WhatsApp flows, with opportunities to collaborate with Product, Content, and Data teams as Mami continues to scale.
This is a rare opportunity to shape both the customer experience and marketing culture of an early-stage, community-driven startup.
What You’ll Do
Take full ownership of the Marketing Automation platform - optimize templates, manage audiences, integrate data, and monitor deliverability.
Build and manage multi-channel customer journeys across Email, SMS, and WhatsApp with personalization, triggers, and A/B testing.
Map end-to-end journeys from sign-up to retention and win-back, including segmentation and dynamic content.
Analyze results using GA4, attribution, cohort analysis, and LTV metrics to inform strategy.
Lead briefs for copy and design, craft action-driven microcopy, and adapt content to target audiences.
Collaborate effectively across teams to ensure smooth delivery and execution.
Requirements
Proven experience in Marketing Automation in B2C/eCommerce or Consumer Apps.
Strong multi-channel experience (Email, SMS, WhatsApp), deliverability, and compliance with opt-in/opt-out regulations.
Hands-on experience with ActiveTrail (mandatory) - building complex flows, advanced segmentation, and templates.
Proficiency in GA4, UTM/attribution, A/B testing, and roadmap management.
Data-driven & analytical, comfortable reading reports, analyzing data, and using insights to optimize flows and campaigns.
Experienced in generating creative ideas and content that drive engagement and results.
Highly communicative, proactive, self-driven, and comfortable collaborating across teams in a fast-moving startup environment.
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.

Description
We’re looking for a sharp, hands-on Marketing Manager who knows how to take a brief and turn it into a well-executed marketing campaign.
You’ll see the full picture, from choosing the right channels and defining the assets needed to building timelines and making sure everything goes live on time and to brief.
You’ll coordinate multiple stakeholders, remove roadblocks, and own campaigns from the initial brief through launch.

Write briefs for Content, Design, and CRM teams
Track progress and ensure deadlines are met
Review deliverables, refine them, and ensure they answer the brief
Integrate relevant AI tools into the marketing workflow

Proven experience in account management, marketing, or a similar role, either in-house or at an advertising, social media, digital, or content agency
Experience managing and executing multi-channel campaigns
Ability to translate a brief into a clear, detailed, and actionable work plan
Experience writing marketing briefs and coordinating multiple teams across multiple campaigns simultaneously
Strong marketing judgment and the ability to identify, evaluate, and refine creative and marketing deliverables
Strong project management, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines

Hands-on experience using and integrating AI tools

תרגום בריפים לתוכניות שיווק 360° ברורות ומעשיות
ניהול ותיאום של כלל הממשקים המעורבים בביצוע הקמפיינים
קבלת בריפים מצוות הסחר וחידוד המטרה השיווקית
ניהול מספר קמפיינים במקביל ותעדוף משימות בהתאם לצורך
תכנון פריסת הקמפיינים בערוצים השונים
הגדרת הנכסים הנדרשים לכל ערוץ
בניית לוחות זמנים, תהליכי עבודה ותוכנית עלייה לאוויר

Mami.description:
Description
We’re looking for a Social Media Manager who knows how to build a brand on social from the ground up and take full ownership of the company’s day-to-day social activity.
You’ll be responsible for the social media domain from planning and creation to community management, performance, and ongoing optimization.
This is an opportunity to shape how the brand shows up across social media, bringing together content, creativity, and business goals. You’ll help define the brand's look & feel, while deciding what content goes live, when, and where, and make sure it all comes together into a consistent and engaging social presence.
You’ll turn trends, ideas, and commercial needs into social content that feels natural to the brand, while managing multiple content streams and stakeholders at the same time.
What You’ll Do
Own the brand’s day-to-day presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp, and Telegram
Build monthly and quarterly content plans and manage the content calendar
Develop creative ideas, recurring formats, and social-first content
Identify trends and adapt them to the brand’s tone and style
Create content using AI tools and integrate them into the creative workflow
Write copy for posts, Stories, Reels, and other social assets
Brief and work with content creators, designers, editors, and external suppliers
Connect social activity to commercial campaigns and sales goals
Collaborate with Marketing, Commercial, CRM, and Sales teams
Monitor performance, analyze results, and optimize accordingly
Requirements
Proven experience managing social media for a significant brand, in-house or at an advertising/social media agency
Hands-on experience creating and managing content across Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms
Strong creative instinct and ability to identify what works on social
Experience building content plans, managing content calendars, and handling multiple content streams
Excellent writing and communication skills
Strong understanding of photography, video editing, and social-first creative
Ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
Hands-on experience with Canva and AI tools for content, video, and creative
Strong understanding of social media metrics and data-driven optimization
Commercial mindset and ability to connect content with business goals
Experience with lifestyle, commerce, or large community-driven brands - big advantage
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.

זו הזדמנות לקחת חלק בעיצוב האופן שבו המותג נוכח ברשת ולחבר בין תוכן, קריאייטיב ומטרות עסקיות. תהיי שותפה להגדרת סיפור המותג ואיך הוא נראה, תוך קבלת החלטות לגבי איזה תוכן עולה, מתי ובאיזה ערוץ, ולוודא שכל החלקים מתחברים לנוכחות עקבית ומעוררת מעורבות בסושיאל.

כישורים מצוינים בניהול פרויקטים במקביל, סדר וארגון וירידה לפרטים

זמינות לעבודה מהמשרד וגמישות לפגישות עם שותפים לפי הצורך
תואר ראשון או שני במנהל עסקים, שיווק או בתחום רלוונטי - יתרון
הסיפור שלנו
אנחנו סטארט-אפ בצמיחה מהירה, המבוסס על קהילה, אמון וחיבור אותנטי. מה שהתחיל כמועדון צרכנות קטן בהובלת מעיין אדם, הפך למותג צרכני מוביל עם למעלה מ-400,000 משתמשים פעילים. כיום החברה מתרחבת לפלטפורמה טכנולוגית שמעצימה יוצרים וקהילות לבנות חוויות קנייה אישיות משלהם, ומגדירה מחדש את הדרך שבה אנשים מתחברים, יוצרים וקונים אונליין.

Mastercard.description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Assistant Controller
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
Dynamic Yield by Mastercard is on the lookout for an Assistant Controller.
The Task-at-Hand:
• Responsible for the company’s worldwide revenue, monitor revenue streams, contracts and agreements and ensuring accurate and appropriate revenue recognition in line with accounting policies. Manage the monthly close process related to revenue, analytical review and other related procedures.
• Monitor the billing and collections team, including proactively driving collection efforts, escalating overdue accounts when needed, partnering with Sales teams to push for timely payments, tracking collection risks, and ensuring adherence to the company's collections policy.
• Managing the entities worldwide (USA, Latvia and Germany) - overseeing accounting functions, monthly reporting packages, monthly close process and some payroll aspects.
• Coordinating and/or preparing tax schedules, VAT returns, tax returns and other statutory reports in local GAAP for all entities.
• Manage audit preparation and coordinate with external auditors as needed.
• Ad Hoc integration projects.
Optimal Skills for Success:
• CPA certification
• 1-2 years of similar experience from global hi-tech companies
• Experience in the preparation of financial reports based on US GAAP
• Strong EXCEL experience
• High level of English
• Ability to work in a fast-paced work environment
• Attention to details
• Well-organized with the ability to prioritize
• Self-learner with the ability to adapt to changing business needs and technologies
• Team player
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
Mastercard.title: Assistant Controller

Job Title:
Lead Software Engineer (Backend & AI)
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Lead Software Engineer (Backend & AI) to drive the design, development, and scaling of advanced backend systems and AI-powered solutions.
In this role, you will combine deep backend engineering expertise with strong AI understanding, leading a team to deliver high-performance, data-driven products. You will play a key role in shaping system architecture, integrating AI capabilities, and ensuring production-grade reliability at scale.
Key Responsibilities:
*Technical Leadership*
Lead the architecture and development of scalable backend systems and APIs
Design and implement AI-driven features, including AI model integration and inference pipelines
Define and enforce best practices for distributed systems, data processing, and system reliability
Own end-to-end system design, including performance, scalability, and security
*AI & Data Engineering*
Collaborate with data scientists/AI engineers to deploy, optimize, and monitor AI models in production
Build and maintain data pipelines and infrastructure supporting AI workloads
Ensure efficient model serving, versioning, and lifecycle management
Optimize performance of AI components (latency, cost, scalability)
*Team Leadership & Mentorship*
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of backend and/or full-stack engineers
Foster a strong engineering culture aligned with Israeli tech ecosystem standards (ownership, fast iteration, innovation)
Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance
*Delivery & Execution*
Partner with Product, Data, and Business teams to define technical solutions
Drive end-to-end delivery of complex projects in a fast-paced environment
Break down ambiguous problems into actionable plans
Ensure timely and high-quality releases
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with AI teams, DevOps, Architects and Product
Translate business needs into robust technical solutions
Communicate complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
*Required Qualifications*
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
8+ years of backend software development experience
2+ years in a leadership or tech lead role
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python and Node.js
Proven experience building large-scale distributed systems
Hands-on experience deploying or integrating machine learning models in production environments
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
*Preferred Qualifications*
Experience in AI systems, including APIs for model inference (e.g., LLMs, recommendation systems, NLP, computer vision)
Familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., Airflow, Vertex AI)
Experience working with real-time data processing systems (Kafka, Spark, Flink)
Background in high-growth startups or Israeli tech companies
Experience with microservices and Kubernetes-based architectures
*Tech Stack*
Backend: Python / Node.js
AI: Bedrock, OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse etc.
Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB, Snowflake
Infrastructure: AWS / GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
Streaming: Kafka
CI/CD: GitHub Actions
*Key Skills & Competencies*
Strong system design and architecture skills
Ability to bridge backend engineering and AI domains
Excellent leadership and mentoring ability
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Effective communication in English (Hebrew is a plus)

Title and Summary
Senior Technical Program Manager
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive execution, alignment, and delivery across Dynamic Yield’s Product House organization. This role sits at the intersection of Product, R&D, and leadership, ensuring that strategy is translated into clear, realistic, and executable plans.
The Senior Technical Program Manager will lead complex cross-functional programs, enable quarterly planning and execution cadences, manage dependencies and risks, and create transparency through dashboards, KPIs, and operating rhythms. In this role, the candidate will join a team of Technical Program Managers who work in close coordination, share methodologies, and continuously improve common practices across the organization. The ideal candidate brings strong technical understanding, structured program leadership, excellent stakeholder management, and the ability to move teams from ambiguity to accountable execution.
Role
• Translate strategy into execution: Partner with Product and R&D to convert product strategy, technical initiatives, and other priorities into clear quarterly execution plans.
• Lead quarterly planning: Facilitate planning timelines, deliverables, ownership, dependencies, and risks across Product Area teams.
• Drive cross-functional alignment: Align Product and R&D Directors, Architects, DevOps, Security, and leadership around shared priorities, scope, timelines, and tradeoffs.
• Manage dependencies and risks: Identify cross-product and technical dependencies early, surface delivery risks, drive mitigation plans, and ensure leadership has the visibility needed to make timely decisions.
• Create execution transparency: Establish dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and operating cadences that provide visibility into progress, delivery confidence, blockers, and outcomes.
• Improve ways of working: Help mature Agile operating model, planning templates, ceremonies, and delivery governance to improve predictability, accountability, quality, and business impact.
• Support backlog health: Partner with Product and R&D to ensure quarterly backlogs are prioritized, refined, estimated, technically aligned, and executable within team capacity.
• Facilitate decision-making: Bring structure to complex discussions, clarify ownership, document decisions, and ensure follow-through on action items.
• Enable value-driven delivery: Connect execution plans to measurable business, technical, and customer outcomes, including quality, productivity, engagement, velocity, and customer value.
• Communicate effectively: Prepare concise, executive-ready updates, program reviews, status reports, retrospectives, and planning materials for Product House and senior leadership forums.
All About You
• 4+ years of experience in technical program management, program management, or a related role within a software or SaaS organization.
• Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, quarterly planning, backlog management, and cross-functional execution.
• Proven ability to manage complex technical programs involving multiple teams, dependencies, stakeholders, and competing priorities.
• Experience working closely with Product, R&D, Architecture, DevOps, Security, and senior leadership.
• Ability to understand technical concepts, architectural tradeoffs, engineering constraints, and delivery risks, and translate them into clear business and execution implications.
• Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority.
• Strong analytical and operational mindset, including experience with KPIs, dashboards, delivery metrics, risk tracking, and executive reporting.
• Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure, and driving teams toward clear ownership, decisions, and outcomes.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Job Title:
Manager, Market Delivery
Overview:
Job Overview:
Customer Delivery Europe is in the center of the Mastercard Europe organization and the key contact between the Divisions, Operations and Technology, Global Products & Solutions and the other business units. We are close to the markets and to our customers.
Market Delivery Managers lead end-to-end project and program management for complex customer onboarding journeys, ensuring seamless integration from business impact to technical execution. They act as strategic consultants and technology relationship managers, guiding customers through operational changes, resolving technical issues, and coordinating with Mastercard subject matter experts. Their role also includes supporting TAM services, driving cross-functional collaboration, and enhancing delivery performance across local markets and key accounts.
Role
Responsible for strategic project/program management as the primary interface between regional customers and internal stakeholders, utilizing local market expertise to facilitate implementations throughout the pre-launch onboarding and post-launch support phases.
• Developing subject matter expert in the Market Delivery area, influencing stakeholders and applying advanced knowledge to drive achievement of area goals and initiatives by contributing to solution development and improvements for existing products, services, and/or processes.
• Executes complex delivery tasks including customer readiness assessments, coordination of training sessions, testing activities, and post-launch support to ensure seamless implementation.
• Supports integration of new products and solutions into the global implementation framework by collaborating with sales, product, and customer success teams to customize delivery plans.
• Identifies potential risks and issues throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively escalating and collaborating on mitigation strategies to minimize impact.
• Ensures seamless integration and deployment of products and solutions within the global framework while accommodating local market nuances.
• Maintains detailed and accurate documentation of delivery activities, outcomes, and lessons learned to support knowledge retention and process improvement.
• Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives by recommending enhancements to delivery processes, tools, and documentation.
• Provides technical and project management expertise during pre-launch and post-launch phases to ensure successful delivery and customer satisfaction.
• Serves as a key point of contact between regional customers and internal stakeholders to ensure clear communication and issue resolution.
• Participates in cross-functional meetings to align delivery efforts with evolving business and customer needs.
• Guides and mentors junior team members through on-the-job experiences, reviewing work and fostering a culture of continuous improvement to grow expertise around their discipline.
All About You
• Understand the payment ecosystem and Mastercard products/services.
• Project management skills.
• Native in Hebrew, Fluent in English
• Profound user of Excel and PowerPoint.
• Analytical thinking and being a person who is usually addressed by others for getting technical advice

Our FDA-cleared technology is already in use, and we are now rapidly scaling globally, offering a unique opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage and help impact the lives of millions of patients worldwide. We are looking for a Commercial Marketing Director to own MeMed’s commercial marketing strategy. This role is responsible for leading value proposition, driving competitive strategy, enabling sales execution, and ensuring strong post-launch performance and market adoption. This is a highly cross-functional role, focused on commercial impact and execution excellence. Translate clinical and product value into compelling, differentiated commercial narratives. Partner with Product, Sales, Medical, and, Regulatory, Market Access to ensure alignment on positioning and pricing strategy. Competitive Strategy Analyze current and emerging competitors, technologies, and market trends. Identify and articulate key differentiators and competitive advantages. Anticipate competitor moves and develop contingency and response plans. Equip commercial teams with clear competitive intelligence and guidance. Medison Pharma.description:
In this role, you will proactively identify best‑in‑class assets, lead rigorous scientific and clinical evaluations, and drive cross‑functional diligence to enable high‑quality, strategic partnering decisions. You will operate at the intersection of science, strategy, and execution, working in close partnership with Medical, Regulatory, and senior leadership to support disciplined growth and long‑term value creation.
Responsibilities
Proactively screen, source, and prioritize best‑in‑class late‑stage assets from Phase 2 through marketed products across rare and severe diseases, leveraging multiple platforms, databases, and industry sources.
Build and manage a robust and high‑quality pipeline of partnership opportunities aligned with Medison’s long‑term growth strategy.
Lead rigorous scientific and clinical evaluations by assessing clinical data versus current standard of care, mechanism of action differentiation, regulatory pathways, and competitive landscape.
Develop clear and data‑driven Target Product Profiles (TPPs) to support scientific, clinical, and strategic positioning.
Conduct comprehensive research, including literature review and data synthesis, to deeply understand disease biology, unmet need, and therapeutic value.
Engage directly with Key Opinion Leaders, clinical investigators, and external experts to validate assumptions and strengthen scientific and clinical assessments.
Drive cross‑functional diligence by partnering closely with function leads, Medical and Regulatory, Commercial, Legal, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders.
Support transaction strategy and execution by providing scientific and clinical input into transaction strategies, diligence materials, and contractual discussions.
Prepare clear, concise, and decision‑ready materials, including evaluation summaries, one‑pagers, presentations, and business cases for senior leadership and governance forums.
Continuously refine and strengthen Search and Evaluation processes, criteria, and scientific convergence frameworks to improve rigor, consistency, and speed of decision‑making.
Act as a trusted thought partner to leadership by surfacing insights, risks, and recommendations that directly influence portfolio strategy and Medison’s growth trajectory.
Represent Medison externally in partnering discussions, scientific meetings, and industry conferences to strengthen Medison’s visibility and network.
Requirements
An advanced degree in Life Sciences (PhD or MD) is required; an MBA or additional business training is a strong advantage.
At least eight years of relevant experience in Search and Evaluation, Business Development, Licensing, Corporate Development, venture capital, or related partnering roles within pharma or biotech.
Proven experience evaluating late‑stage assets from Phase 2 through marketed products, preferably in rare and severe diseases.
Strong understanding of drug development, clinical data interpretation, regulatory pathways, and competitive dynamics.
Demonstrated experience developing Target Product Profiles and comparing clinical data to existing standards of care.
Proven ability to lead cross‑functional diligence teams and work closely with Business Development deal leads throughout the transaction lifecycle.
Strong scientific credibility with the ability to engage confidently with Key Opinion Leaders, investigators, and senior internal stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to create clear, concise, executive‑level decision materials.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple complex evaluations in parallel in a fast‑paced environment.
An ownership‑driven, hands‑on leadership style with strong strategic thinking, sound judgment, and business acumen.

Responsibilities:
As our IT Manager, you will lead all internal IT operations and infrastructure, including:
Managing and maintaining our Microsoft and Google Workspace environments
Overseeing network infrastructure, connectivity, and security
Providing hands-on IT support to employees
Implementing and maintaining security best practices
Managing hardware, software, SaaS tools, permissions, and onboarding/offboarding
Working closely with security and engineering teams
Owning IT policies, inventory, and documentation
Required Experience and Skills:
3–5+ years of experience in IT management or senior IT roles
Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Azure AD, Intune, and Windows environments
Strong experience with Google Workspace administration
Solid understanding of networking: VPN, firewalls, routing, switching, Wi-Fi
Experience managing SaaS tools, SSO, identity, and access management
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and support a fast-moving startup
Strong communication skills and a service-oriented mindset
Nice to Have:
Experience in cybersecurity or tech startups
Familiarity with macOS management
Knowledge of security frameworks (ISO, SOC2, etc.)
Why Join Us?
If you’re passionate about IT, security, and technology and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.
Be part of a fast-growing cybersecurity company protecting global brands
Work with cutting-edge technologies
Opportunity to own and shape IT infrastructure from the ground up
Great people, great culture, and meaningful work
Location: Tel Aviv District, Israel
If you think you could be our new team member, please send your resume to
jobs@memcyco.com

About the position
This full-time position is based in Amsterdam and requires traveling to various Mindspace sites in Amsterdam and Utrecht and reporting to the Regional Sales Manager.
Your Sales Responsibilities:
You will be responsible for expanding and deepening our relationships with existing clients, as well as successfully converting new leads.
Owning all aspects of the pre-sales and sales of our spaces, as well as customer success, retention, and upsell, you’ll play a key role in our sales efforts through the qualification of leads and deal-closing.
Qualify SMB leads - convert them to tours and closed deals (inbound & outbound)
Provide a suitable proposal offer, based on Mindspace guidelines
Follow up with the customer, maintaining a consistent, open channel
Your Customer Experience Responsibilities:
Building and maintaining a strong community via networking and events
Engaging, growing and nurturing the Mindspace community; keeping things fresh and interesting
Creating an inclusive environment that fosters collaboration and creativity — both internally and externally
Maintaining ongoing communication with operation and maintenance teams to ensure that all processes run smoothly
Being the point of contact for your members and solving all member-related issues
Requirements
Demonstrated customer service and sales experience
Excellent team player
Experience working with various companies and stakeholders
Strong oral and written communication skills both in Dutch and English
Multitasking is a must! You must be able to balance multiple projects at the same time
Available to work 5 days on-site(s)
A ‘can do’ approach!
Critical competencies for success:
Multitasking is a must! You must be able to balance multiple projects at the same time and adhere to strict deadlines (strong time management skills are key)
Strong decision making: you need to be able to make considered, responsible decisions on a whim, when things don’t go according to plan
You must be a thorough, self-aware worker who’s able to recognize mistakes, and take the necessary steps to fix them
Problem solving – you are a highly resourceful thinker who is quick on their feet and a fast learner
Ability to work independently based on targets and goals, and raise any flags on time
Ability to adjust quickly to a fast-paced, changing environment
Please submit your application in English.

What you'll do
Acting as the primary point of contact for members, ensuring a seamless and high-quality experience at all times
Managing member accounts and ongoing relationships, with a strong focus on satisfaction, retention, and long-term loyalty

Ensuring close collaboration with the Sales Team to never miss an upsell or contract extension opportunity.

Creating a welcoming, professional, and hospitality-driven environment tailored to the needs of corporate and enterprise members

A proactive, practical mindset with the ability to think on your feet and take initiative

Mindspace.description:
About the position
This full-time position, based in Israel, you will be responsible for leading and managing all end-to-end financial processes across designated markets. As a key member of the finance team, the Controller will serve as a strategic finance business partner, supporting operational and commercial decision-making with strong analytical insight. The role requires ownership of accounting, reporting, and financial controls, ensuring all activities are executed in full compliance with local regulations and company policies. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented professional with a hands-on approach, strong business acumen, and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment while driving continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
In general, the Controller is responsible for managing the Finance activities of Mindspace in Israel market, supporting overall business objectives and maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements.
Key responsibilities:
Manage Day to Day Finance Operations Activities:
Supervise the Invoicing and Collection Processes. Ensure invoicing, revenue recognition and cash collection is done on time and resolve complicated billing/debt collection issues.
Supervise Account Payable processes, ensure supplier payments/inquiries are promptly executed aligned with Mindspace’s Payment Policy
Budgeting and Forecasting
Develop Budgets: Lead the budgeting process for each market, ensuring alignment with overall strategy.
Prepare financial forecasts and projections as needed
Variance Analysis: Conduct variance analysis to compare actual performance against budgets, and provide recommendations for improvements.
Cash Flow Management
Monitor Cash Flow: Oversee cash flow management to ensure sufficient liquidity for operational needs across markets.
Optimize Working Capital: Implement strategies to optimize working capital and manage accounts receivable and payable effectively.
Prepare and Review Financial Statements:
Ensure accurate and timely preparation of consolidated financial statements for all markets. Including preparation of quarterly Reporting Package and related working paper according to IFRS.
Monitor and analyze financial performance metrics across different markets to provide actionable insights.
Engage with Stakeholders:
Analyze, report and communicate financial performance, issues, and strategies with Internal and external stakeholders and work closely with other departments to align financial activities with business objectives.
Act as a Finance Business Partner to your markets providing financial data and insight to utilize data driven decision making
Compliance and Reporting:
Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulations, in particular compliance with IFRS 16.
Team Leadership and Development
Supervise and mentor local bookkeepers, ensuring effective performance and development.
Systems and Processes
Identify and implement process improvements and tools to enhance financial operations and reporting efficiency.
Experience & Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in accounting and CPA from a Big 4 accounting firm, with a minimum of 2 years of experience after internship. Mandatory
Previous experience being an assistant controller/controller for an International entity. Mandatory
High level of English and Hebrew - Mandatory
Experience managing Global Accounting Operations - Advantage
Experience being a Finance Business Partner - Advantage
Excellent systems/tools capabilities including Excel, G-Sheet, SAP and FP&A systems (Datarails - advantage)
Exceptional knowledge of finance, accounting, budgeting, cost accounting and cost control principles, and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.
Advanced knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting best practices, laws, standards
Analytical ability to develop and implement improvements or recommendations
Please submit your application in English

Mindspace.description:
as a Front Desk Associate in Berlin!
Founded and led by a team of passionate professionals, Mindspace is committed to creating an environment where top talent can thrive!
Take the first step toward your ideal team
Drop your CV below and let’s see where this goes — your next chapter might start here.
About Mindspace
At Mindspace, work doesn't feel like work.Since 2014, we've been creating flexible, design-led workspaces across Europe, Israel, and the US where people - startups, enterprises, entrepreneurs, and digital nomads - can thrive. With over 15,000 members in 45 locations, we blend hospitality, style, and innovation so every space feels alive.
Why you'll love it here
Because at Mindspace, people show up, take ownership, support each other, and keep things moving - even when things change.
Reporting to the Area Manager, you are the heartbeat of the location: the face at the front desk, the person who keeps things moving, and the first to notice when something needs attention. You'll work side by side with the Community Managers, get involved in everything from daily operations to member events, gaining real insight into what it takes to keep members happy and the space running seamlessly. If you like variety, people, and the satisfaction of a day well run - this is your kind of role.
Are you the ideal Mindspacer?
You're switched-on and genuinely enjoy being around people. You handle a busy front desk the same way you handle everything else - calmly, efficiently, and with a smile. You pick things up quickly, juggle priorities without dropping them, and take pride in the small details that make a big difference. You know the city, you're curious about the startup world, and you understand that great service isn't a department - it's an attitude.
What you'll do
Be the first point of contact for members and guests - welcoming, present, and always ready to help
Run the front desk during operating hours, keeping everything organised and on track
Handle maintenance coordination, mail, shipping, supplies and equipment
Support the Community Managers on community tasks and take an active role in bringing them to life
Spot and resolve member issues before they become real problems
Help maintain the upkeep and smooth running of the space day to day
What we need from you
1–2 years of experience in customer service, sales or a similar hands-on role
Strong organisational skills and a natural ability to multitask
Fluent in English and comfortable communicating in German
A people-first mindset and a practical, get-it-done approach
Familiarity with the Berlin startup and business ecosystem is a big plus
At Mindspace, we understand that work is more than just a job. That's why we provide our employees with exceptional benefits, such as:
Generous annual leave allowance
Meal benefits via a lunch card
Gift vouchers on birthdays and Christmas
Subsidized public transport subscriptions
Engaging team and end-of-year events
If you love creating great experiences, take pride in the details, and want to be part of a team that genuinely cares about the people in its spaces - Mindspace is your kind of place.
Please submit your application in English.
Mindspace is an equal-opportunity employer.
