Reco.description:
Description
We're looking for a sharp, strategic Product Marketing Manager to own the voice of Reco in the market. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the intersection of product, sales, and go-to-market at a moment when the security landscape is being reshaped by AI.
You'll translate complex capabilities from SaaS posture management to agentic AI security and non-human identity governance into narratives that resonate with security leaders. You'll build competitive programs that arm the field, shape how analysts and buyers understand emerging AI risk categories, and partner with Product and Engineering to ensure the market perspective drives what we build.
You'll be the connective tissue between what Reco does and why it matters to buyers, to practitioners, to analysts, and to our own teams.
Responsibilities
Build and operationalize a competitive intelligence program that keeps the company consistently informed about the market, including the fast-evolving AI security and agentic security landscape.
Own win/loss analysis; synthesize findings into actionable insights for product, sales, and leadership.
Track how competitors are positioning around AI agents, non-human identities, and security for AI tools and define how Reco stands apart.
Be the go-to expert on how Reco compares to the market and how we should talk about it.
Market & Customer Intelligence
Continuously track emerging use cases, shifting buyer needs, and market trends, including how AI adoption is creating new security requirements and translate those signals into strategic action.
Run customer interviews and synthesize insights from across the field to keep Reco grounded in real-world problems, particularly around AI agent risk, shadow AI, and non-human identity sprawl.
Monitor analyst coverage and category formation around agentic AI security and AI-SPM and help Reco shape the narrative.
Feed intelligence into product, marketing campaigns, and executive strategy.
Storytelling & GTM Narrative
Translate complex technical capabilities including AI-driven detection, agentic security, and security for AI tools into clear, outcome-driven narratives that articulate customer value and business impact.
Develop and own Reco's core GTM messaging from platform positioning to use-case-level stories across personas, including the emerging CISO conversation around AI risk governance.
Create content that works across the funnel: website, decks, one-pagers, blog posts, and customer-facing collateral.
Product & Engineering Partnership
Serve as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering, bringing market, customer, field, and competitive perspectives, especially around AI security, into roadmap decisions.
Lead go-to-market planning for new feature and product launches, including capabilities in agentic security and AI posture management, ensuring messaging and enablement are ready at launch.
Help define how new capabilities are packaged, named, and positioned before they ship.
Sales & Field Enablement
Create the tools sellers need to have better conversations: messaging frameworks, competitive battle cards, discovery guidance, and objection handling, including how to position Reco in AI security conversations.
Partner closely with Sales leadership to understand where deals are won and lost, and close the gaps.
Deliver regular enablement sessions to keep the field sharp and confident on evolving topics like AI agents, non-human identities, and security for AI.
Requirements
5+ years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in cybersecurity, identity, or adjacent security verticals.
Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow how AI agents, copilots, and LLM-based tools are reshaping enterprise workflows and the security challenges they introduce.
Proven ability to distill complex technical concepts including emerging topics like agentic AI risk, non-human identities, and AI-SPM into crisp, compelling narratives.
Hands-on experience building competitive programs, running win/loss analysis, and turning insights into sales tools.
Strong cross-functional instincts you know how to influence without authority and build trust with Product, Sales, and Marketing peers.
A bias toward execution: you can move from strategy to artifact quickly, without sacrificing quality.
Reco.title: Product Marketing Manager

Reco.description:
Description
We are looking for a high-level accounting leader who can manage the company's daily financial operations, accounting records, internal controls, and regulatory reporting. They will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and lead the accounting team to guarantee that all financial statements are accurate and comply with US GAAP or IFRS standards. The Corporate Controller will provide comprehensive financial updates to senior management by evaluating, analyzing, and reporting appropriate data points, Guide financial decisions by applying company policies and procedures to current economic landscape, Develop, implement, and maintain financial controls and guidelines, Maximize payroll efficiency through innovative process development and help develop and support short and long-term operational strategies.
Responsibilities
Accounting Operations: Direct daily workflows for the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and cash management.
Financial Reporting: Oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to produce timely and precise financial statements.
Internal Controls: Build, monitor, and enforce financial policies and internal controls to protect company assets and prevent fraud.
Audit and Tax Management: Lead internal and external audits, and coordinate corporate tax filings with outside advisors.
Budgeting and Analysis: Partner with financial planning teams to track budget variances, review cash flow, and guide operational choices.
Team Leadership: Hire, train, and mentor accounting staff to build a high-performance work culture.
Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is a plus.
Certification: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation is strongly preferred or required by most employers.
Experience: 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including several years in a management or leadership role. Out of the 5 years of experience, at least 2 years as a Corporate Controller
Technical Skills: Deep expertise in US GAAP, regulatory compliance, strong understanding of economic and banking processes and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems like NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle.
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years experience as a senior-level accounting or finance manager
Strong working knowledge of detailed financial data analysis
Proven payroll experience, with a focus on streamlining accounting processes
Exemplary history of financial project management
Working knowledge of federal, state, and local tax compliance regulations and reporting
Experience with AI tools and streamlining workflows.
Reco.title: Corporate Controller

Reco.description:
Description
Reco is the leader in SaaS & AI Security the only approach that secures AI sprawl across SaaS apps & agents. Close the security gap in your expanding AI footprint.
Reco helps organizations discover, govern, and secure their SaaS and AI ecosystem, enabling security teams to manage risk and confidently adopt AI technologies at scale.
About the Role
﻿ We are looking for a Product Manager with a strong cybersecurity background and proven experience building AI-powered products . You will own product strategy and execution end-to-end, working closely with Engineering, Security Research, and GTM teams to deliver innovative solutions that help customers secure their SaaS and AI environments.
Responsibilities
Lead the product lifecycle from strategy and roadmap to delivery and launch.
Define and drive AI-powered product capabilities and user experiences.
Collaborate closely with Engineering, Security Research, and GTM teams.
Work directly with customers to validate product direction and prioritize opportunities.
Define and monitor KPIs to measure product success and drive continuous improvement.
Translate complex security and AI challenges into scalable product solutions.
Requirements
4–5 years of Product Management experience, including experience at a cybersecurity company .
Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand data models, system architecture, and how security detections operate under the hood.
Proven experience delivering AI-powered product capabilities from concept to production, with hands-on involvement in defining, validating, and launching AI-driven features.
Strong customer-facing skills with a demonstrated ability to transform ambiguous security challenges into clear, validated product opportunities.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment, building products from ambiguity without predefined playbooks or processes.
Data-driven mindset with experience defining product metrics, measuring outcomes, and using insights to drive prioritization and decision-making.
Proven track record of partnering closely with engineering teams to deliver highly technical products.
Strong background in security-related domains.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align technical and business stakeholders around product strategy and execution.
Reco.title: Product Manager

Reco.description:
Description
Reco is a fast-growing SaaS security company that helps organizations secure their SaaS and AI environments by detecting identity-based threats and risky configurations.
We are looking for a Threat Detection Engineer to analyze large-scale SaaS security data, investigate incidents, and develop advanced threat detection strategies.
You will work closely with security researchers and customers to identify emerging threats and improve detection capabilities across SaaS environments.
Responsibilities
Threat Analysis and Research: Dive deep into terabytes of SaaS Application data to identify new attack vectors, emerging threats, and vulnerabilities across various attack surfaces.
Stay up-to-date with the latest cybersecurity trends and contribute to the development of cutting-edge threat detection methodologies.
Incident Investigation: Utilize your technical prowess to investigate complex SaaS & AI security incidents, analyzing data from diverse SaaS applications to uncover the root causes and methods of attack.
False Positive Reduction: Leverage your expertise in data analysis and correlation to fine-tune detection rules and algorithms, minimizing false positives and enhancing the accuracy of our platform's threat alerts.
Thought Leadership and Community Engagement: Drive thought leadership initiatives by creating technical blog posts, delivering webinars, and speaking at conferences to share insights, educate the community, and enhance the company's reputation in the cybersecurity landscape.
Be at the forefront of the Reco mission and work closely with Reco customers regarding cyber security investigations and incidents detected in their environments
Collaborate with security researchers and data scientists to define new threat detection strategies based on SaaS attack vectors and industry trends.
Continuously monitor and analyze SaaS attack techniques, adapting security posture to evolving threats.
Work with APIs and integrations to ingest security logs from various SaaS platforms, correlating signals to detect real threats.
Requirements
A background of at least 5 years in cybersecurity, preferably in SOC, SIEM, Threat Intelligence, or Cloud Security
Experience with SaaS security challenges, such as shadow IT, OAuth risks, IDP misconfigurations, and excessive permissions.
Hands-on experience with security data analysis, including large-scale log processing, anomaly detection, and behavioral analytics.
Proficiency in SQL (e.g., ClickHouse) for querying security events and correlating threat indicators.
Strong understanding of identity-based attacks, insider threats, and SOC detection methodologies.
Familiarity with SIEM and XDR solutions (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, Chronicle) and their role in modern detection engineering.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to triage security incidents and optimize detection rules.
Advantages:
Familiarity with SaaS security best practices, including least-privilege access, OAuth governance, and SSPM.
Knowledge of SaaS security frameworks (e.g., SSPM, CASB).
Experience with IDP security (Okta, Azure AD, Google IAM) and detecting identity-related SaaS threats.
Hands-on experience with Threat Hunting and / or Detection engineering in SaaS environments.
Understanding of SaaS API security and experience analyzing integrations with third-party applications.
Reco.title: Security Researcher

Reco.description:
Description
Reco is the leader in SaaS & AI Security the only approach that secures AI sprawl across SaaS apps & agents. Close the security gap in your expanding AI footprint.
Reco helps organizations discover, govern, and secure their SaaS and AI ecosystem, enabling security teams to manage risk and confidently adopt AI technologies at scale.
Responsibilities
Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of backend, frontend, and research engineers.
Act as a hands-on technical leader : design critical systems, write production code when needed, and set a high engineering bar.
Own backend systems end-to-end, from architecture and design through implementation and production delivery .
Drive technical direction and architectural decisions for large-scale cybersecurity platforms .
Lead the delivery of complex LLM- and agent-based solutions to production , ensuring they meet enterprise standards for reliability, scalability, security, and observability.
Partner closely with Product, Research, and Client Services to translate complex technical challenges into clear, high-impact product capabilities.
Ensure backend systems are built with a strong emphasis on security, correctness, and long-term maintainability .
Review code, guide design decisions, and promote best practices across the team.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Requirements
7+ years of experience in backend software development, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or team lead role .
Proven experience designing and building scalable, highly available backend systems in production.
Strong background in building cybersecurity platforms , with hands-on experience in areas such as:
Identity and access management
Authentication and authorization mechanisms
Policy, permissions, and access-control models
Security-related data processing or control planes
Deep understanding of software design principles such as SOLID , modularity, testability, and long-term maintainability.
Experience leading systems through the full software development lifecycle: design, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to align technical, research, and product stakeholders.
Team & Personality
A true team player (“soul player”) who prioritizes team success over individual credit.
Leads by example, takes responsibility for outcomes, and creates a culture of trust, openness, and technical excellence.
Comfortable balancing people leadership , technical depth, and delivery pressure.
High ownership mindset and strong sense of accountability to customers and production systems.
Bonus Points If You Have
Experience applying cybersecurity principles specifically to SaaS environments , including:
Single Sign-On (SSO), MFA, and identity federation (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect)
SaaS application configuration and security controls
Monitoring and detection of suspicious or risky behavior within SaaS applications
Integrating with SaaS APIs for security visibility and enforcement
Familiarity with Go, Scala, Python , and modern backend ecosystems.
Experience with microservices , event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, Azure, or GCP .
Exposure to LLMs, NLP, or agent-based systems , including taking complex solutions from concept to production.
BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or equivalent practical experience.

Your team will focus strictly on the electronic and signal aspects of drones—specifically communication protocols, flight controllers, and GNSS systems—rather than their electro-mechanical or aerodynamic properties.
Your primary objective will be to deconstruct, study, and understand modern drone technologies to empower our Electronic Warfare (EW) R&D team with actionable insights for drone detection, jamming, and spoofing. You will manage daily operations, track progress, build non-standard test platforms, and maintain a priority-based threat intelligence matrix.
Key Responsibilities:
● Lead and mentor a small team of junior researchers. Assign tasks, manage ongoing lab/field activities, and track research progress to ensure milestones are met efficiently.
● Build non-standard drones using custom or off-the-shelf components. Conduct rigorous lab and field tests to study their electronic behavior under various conditions.
●Perform deep dives into drone communication protocols (RF links, Wi-Fi, proprietary telemetry), flight controller firmware, and GNSS navigation systems to identify vulnerabilities and operational mechanics.
● Translate technical findings into practical, actionable insights for the EW R&D team to improve our counter-drone capabilities (detection, RF jamming, and GPS/GNSS spoofing).
● Continuously monitor the internet, forums, dark webs, and tech spaces for emerging drone technologies, DIY trends, and evolving tactics.
● Maintain a continuously updated, priority-based "drone threat list." Create detailed, evidence-based reports on new technologies with clearly cited sources, and confidently present these findings across the company.
Requirements
●No formal academic degree is required. However, deep, provable hands-on experience and familiarity with the drone/sUAS ecosystem is absolutely mandatory.
●Intimate knowledge of drone electronics, flight controllers (e.g., Betaflight, ArduPilot, PX4), communication links (e.g., ExpressLRS, Crossfire, DJI OcuSync), GNSS modules, SDR and RF Experience.
● Proven ability to manage projects, track tasks, and guide a small technical team in a highly dynamic R&D environment.
● Strong ability to connect how a drone communicates and navigates to how it can be detected, disrupted, or spoofed.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills to author clear, sourced reports and brief R&D engineering teams.

Regulus is an agile defense-tech startup tackling the most complex challenges in counter-drone and uncrewed defense. With hundreds of combat-proven systems deployed by the IDF and global partners, we are now engineering the next generation of C-UxS (Counter-Uncrewed Systems). We leverage advanced electronic warfare and kinetic measures to detect and neutralize hostile threats. If you want to push technological boundaries while safeguarding Israel and our allies, join us at this pivotal stage of our growth.
We are looking for a Junior Bid & Business Operations Specialist to own and manage end-to-end tender and proposal processes , while supporting the Sales team in identifying and developing new business opportunities.
This is an early-career role with significant ownership and responsibility. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing bids from initial tender review through final submission, while working closely with internal stakeholders across the company.
﻿Key Responsibilities
Bid & Proposal Operations
Own end-to-end responses to tenders, RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and strategic proposals.
Analyze tender documents to identify requirements, risks, gaps, contractual obligations, and clarification points.
Build bid plans, manage timelines, and coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure all required inputs are delivered on time.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Serve as the primary point of coordination for bid-related activities between Sales and Product & Engineering, Operations & Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and other relevant functions.
Sales Operations Support
Conduct market, customer, project, and competitor research to support business opportunities.
Support the Sales team with opportunity assessment, customer research, market overviews, competitive analyses, and sales-support materials.
Note: This is a non-technical, early-career Bid and Business Operations role . The position focuses on bid management, commercial and operational coordination, research, and cross-functional execution throughout the sales and bidding process. No technical sales or engineering background is required.
Requirements
Ability and willingness to work ON SITE in HaifaAbility and willingness to work ON SITE in HaifaBachelor’s degree in a relevant field
2 years of experience in an administrative, operational, project coordination, tenders, proposals, or similar role
Exceptional English proficiency, particularly in reading, writing, and professional drafting
Ability to read, understand, and summarize lengthy and complex documents.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify requirements, gaps, inconsistencies, and potential risks.
Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Ability to work with multiple teams and stakeholders and support cross-functional processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to learn.
Proactive, responsible, detail-oriented, and eager to grow professionally
﻿ Ability and willingness to work ON SITE (Haifa)
Advantages
Previous exposure to tenders, bids, proposals, or RFPs .
Experience working with government, defense, or industrial organizations .
Spanish and/or additional languages.
Background or education in Law .
Regulus.title: Junior Bid Proposal & Business Operations Specialist

Regulus.description:
Description
Regulus is an agile defense-tech startup developing next-generation Counter-Uncrewed Systems (C-UxS), leveraging advanced electronic warfare and kinetic technologies. With combat-proven systems deployed globally, we are expanding our European footprint.
We are seeking an experienced B2G Sales Manager to lead defense and homeland security sales activities across Germany and additional European markets.
This position is ON-SITE.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and execute B2G (Business-to-Government) sales activities across Germany and Europe.
Identify, engage, and manage relationships with governmental customers, defense agencies, and major system integrators.
Drive full sales lifecycle: opportunity identification, bid and proposal activities, qualification, pricing, contract negotiation, and closing.
Develop and execute strategic sales plans to expand market presence and achieve revenue targets.
Understand customer technical requirements and translate them into actionable proposals in collaboration with the engineering and product teams.
Represent the company at defense exhibitions, industry events, and governmental meetings across Europe.
Maintain strong awareness of procurement programs, competitors, and regulatory environments within the European defense & HLS ecosystem.
Requirements
The following requirements are essential for success in this role:
Proven B2G sales experience
Proven sales experience within GNSS, RF, Radar, EW, or Defense Electronic Systems domains
Strong network within the German defense industry and familiarity with procurement channels (e.g., Bundeswehr, BAAINBw, system integrators).
Fluent German (native or near-native level) AND Fluent English
Self-driven, strategic thinker with the ability to operate independently and as part of an international team.
Willingness to travel within Germany and internationally as required (40-50% of the time)
Must be eligible to work in Israel and able to work on-site.
﻿ Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline (Master’s – advantage).

Repair Carbon.description: Production Line Technician RepAir , an emerging start-up developing innovative electrochemical carbon capture technologies to fight climate change, is scaling up its production operations in Mevo Carmel (Yokneam), Israel. We are looking for a hands-on , motivated Production Line Technician to join our Production team. You will run the electrode production line day to day — manufacturing electrodes, operating the equipment and driving production forward as we scale from pilot to serial manufacturing of our CO₂ capture technology. This is a full-time position , based on-site at the company's facility in Mevo Carmel (Yokneam), Israel. Key Responsibilities: - Hands-on manufacturing of electrodes across the full process – from slurry preparation and coating (blade / roller / slot-die) to MEA fabrication and cell/stack assembly - Operating and monitoring production equipment and instrumentation on the electrochemical production line - Performing in-line quality checks, routine maintenance and troubleshooting - Documenting production data and ensuring compliance with safety requirements - Driving production forward together with process and mechanical engineers Requirements: - Technician diploma, or equivalent hands-on production experience (3+ years) - Good mechanical skills and comfort working with machines, jigs and measurement tools - Proficiency in English, both written and verbal - Highly motivated with a "big-picture" attitude who takes full ownership and responsibility - A passion to learn new things and master new techniques and procedures - Precise, detail-oriented and committed to quality and safety - A great team player who thrives in a dynamic environment – flexible, adaptable and open, not rigid Advantages: - Experience in relevant production environments (e.g., fuel cells, batteries, electrolyzers) - Experience with coating processes (e.g., slot-die, roll-to-roll) or electrode / ink preparation - Familiarity with assembly of electrochemical cells or stacks Why Join Us? - Innovative mission – work with cutting-edge technology that makes a real environmental impact - Hands-on impact – a key role in building groundbreaking production capabilities for large-scale CO₂ capture - Professional growth – grow with us as we scale up our production operations Contact Details: Please submit your resume to Jobs@repair-carbon.com and reference job # in the subject line ‍
Repair Carbon.title: Production Line Technician

Repair Carbon.description: Electrode Production Technician (Electrochemical Manufacturing) Location: Mevo Carmel, Yokneam, Israel Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Electrode Production Technician to join our growing production team. This is a hands-on role in a wet / chemical / electrochemical production environment — not a mechanical assembly line or a classic manufacturing floor. If your background is limited to mechanical assembly, electronics production, or automated serial lines only, this role is likely not the right fit. You will run the electrode production line day to day — preparing chemistries, operating equipment, coating, assembling cells, and driving production forward as we scale up. Ridewithvia.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.
As a Staff ML Engineer at Via, you will play a central role in shaping how millions of riders and drivers move through our cities every day. Our team sits at the intersection of machine learning, optimization, and real-world operations - turning complex, multi-dimensional challenges into the real-time intelligence that powers Via's mass-scale automated dispatch system. This is a rare opportunity to work on problems that are genuinely hard, at a scale that is genuinely rare, where the solutions you build have a direct and visible impact on the efficiency and reliability of transit networks around the world.
About the Role:
Own the development of ML models and optimization algorithms that drive Via's real-time dispatch system - making smart, scalable decisions across thousands of simultaneous rides, drivers, and operational constraints.
Design and implement online algorithms for real-time decision-making, balancing system utilization with a consistently high quality of service for riders - where every millisecond and every percentage point of efficiency matters.
Model and mathematically represent competing demands on Via's system, translating messy real-world operational complexity into elegant, tractable formulations that can be solved at scale.
Use sophisticated statistical methods to analyse demand patterns, traffic dynamics, and fleet performance - generating insights that directly inform algorithm development and operational strategy.
Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to bring complex algorithmic work to life in production - owning the full journey from research and prototyping through to real-world deployment and iteration.
About You:
Advanced degree (M.Sc. or PhD) in Computer Science, Mathematics or a closely related field, with a strong background in Machine Learning.
8+ years of industry experience shipping machine learning models at production scale - you've taken hard problems from whiteboard to deployment and know what it takes to make research work in the real world.
Deep, hands-on expertise in Machine Learning, with significant experience in reinforcement learning for complex, dynamic or constrained systems.
Excellent coding skills in Python or similar, with the ability to turn rigorous ideas into working, maintainable solutions that perform under real operational load.
Strong applied research mindset: able to translate ambiguous business/operational challenges into tractable ML formulations and measurable impact.
Naturally curious, fast-learning, and collaborative - you bring strong communication skills and genuine intellectual generosity to the teams you work with.
Compensation and Benefits
Joining a global employer with over 700 mobility deployments in 40+ countries.
Our product impacts millions of users around the world providing alternative transport solutions that are more: efficient and accessible, changing cities to make them greener.
Competitive compensation package which includes base salary and stock options.
Health insurance with a discount for family members.
Hybrid work and a lovely office situated in the heart of TLV, in Midtown, close to the light rail and train station.
Career development and growth opportunities.
Other perks: Freefit and other sports lessons, 10bis/Cibus - you choose!, happy hours, team events, communities and many more benefits.
There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?
Via is an equal opportunity employer.
We’re Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.
Our teams of worldclass engineers, data-scientists, product managers, operations specialists, marketers, transit experts and more bring cutting-edge AI-powered software and innovative technology-enabled operations to our partners across the globe. Founded in 2012, Via builds solutions to digitize, automate, and enable data-driven decision making for entire transportation networks; fixed-route buses, microtransit, paratransit, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and more.
If you’re excited to be at the forefront of modernizing the future of transportation, are up for solving tough problems, and willing to become/already are a transit nerd, we are the place for you. Even if your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other opportunities.
Ready to join the ride?
Via is an equal opportunity employer.

Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint - we’ve got huge goals.
As a Senior Platform Engineer at Via, you’ll join our R&D center in TLV. You’ll be part of a team of developers and devops engineers, directly contributing to our product by using cutting-edge technologies. You’ll take a critical part in our mission to shape the future of transportation, affecting tens of thousands of riders daily worldwide.
The Platform Group is a cross-functional group dedicated to building and maintaining the robust foundation on which Via operates. This team is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD systems, and tools that empower our development and production environments.
With a focus on enhancing developer experience, operational efficiency, and reliability, the team drives initiatives that:
Design and implement scalable and secure cloud infrastructure.
Develop and maintain Kubernetes clusters and related tools, ensuring high availability and performance.
Manage edge gateways, WAF solutions, and other critical infrastructure components.
Define and enforce CI/CD standards to streamline development and delivery workflows
Build tools and automation to enhance productivity across engineering teams.
Ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of production infrastructure.

Define infrastructure standards for dev teams
Design, implement and develop tools for controlling infrastructure of micro services
Build CI/CD automation and templates with GitLab
Build, maintain and operate AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure
Develop and maintain an in-depth understanding of the applications and architecture at Via
Work in contact with other teams across the company to ensure smooth and documented changes to all environments
Identify and resolve problems in mission-critical services, automating remediation procedures to prevent recurrences
Bring ideas to the table, take ownership over their project timelines and deliverables and help us scale
Who You Are:
BSc. Computer Science or similar.
5+ years of professional experience in backend or full-stack development in a product development team. Object oriented programming programming experience is required.
3+ years experience as Devops/SRE in a production environment
2+ years experience with containers, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD
2+ years experience with AWS or GCP/Azure
1+ years experience with CICD - GitLab/Jenkins/Github actions/etc.
Experience with networking, distributed systems, SQL and NoSQL databases
Experience with Unix/Linux operating systems internals and administration
Fluent in English language
Advantage - Experienced with declarative IaC tools like Terraform, Cloudformation or Pulumi
Commitment to a collaborative environment infused with professionalism, integrity, passion, and accountability

Career development and growth opportunities.

Building the world's most efficient, equitable, and sustainable transportation network for all passengers, including those with limited mobility, those without smartphones, and unbanked populations — Via works with its partners to lower the costs of public transit while providing transportation options that rival the convenience of a personal car while reducing environmental impact.
At the intersection of transportation and technology, Via is a visionary market leader that combines software innovation with sophisticated service design and operational expertise to fundamentally improve the way the world moves, providing technology in 650 communities and more than 35 countries and counting.

מהתרבות שלנו וממה שאנחנו מחפשות בך.   קצת עלינו אנחנו RiseUp, והמשימה שלנו היא לעזור לאנשים להיות בטוב עם כסף. אנחנו בונות מוצר פיננסי שהופך את ניהול הכסף לחוויה פשוטה, מרימה ומצמיחה, שמשפיעה לטובה על חיי הלקוחות שלנו.   חלק מה-Benefits שלנו מודל עבודה היברידי: אנחנו מאמינות בשילוב שמאפשר גם עבודה מהבית וגם מפגש אישי. מיקום מרכזי: המשרדים שלנו בתל אביב, במרחק הליכה קצר מתחנת הרכבת הקלה. בואו לעבוד איתנו שם פרטי שם משפחה נייד אימייל רוצה להוסיף משהו? Linkedin קורות חיים שליחה על החברה מי אנחנו אבטחת מידע לעבוד איתנו ביקורות מידע ללקוח בלוג שאלות ותשובות מרכז המידע לחסוך עם RiseUp תנאי שימוש מדיניות פרטיות תקנון תוכנית

About the Role
We are looking for a Video Education Manager to own product education end-to-end. You'll be the face of Riverside on camera—creating every video yourself from script to final cut, producing product education videos for our YouTube channel, delivering product demos, and developing the new Riverside University into the ultimate learning hub for our users.
This is a high-ownership and highly cross-functional role for someone who is equal parts teacher, creator, and product expert, and who wants their work seen by a global audience. You are also the ultimate proof that the product works: every video you publish is produced in Riverside, by you, end-to-end.
On Your Day-to-Day
You will drive product education strategy and independently produce every video—scripting, shooting, and editing as the primary face of Riverside on camera. You'll scale our YouTube tutorials, build Riverside University into a premier learning hub, and teach new features the moment they ship. Working closely with Product, Marketing, Design, and Social, you'll ensure our content looks exceptional while channeling user feedback directly back into our product lifecycle.

On-camera experience: You're comfortable and genuinely good presenting to a lens, and it shows. Include links to yourself on camera in your application (a reel, a YouTube channel, tutorials, a talk, anything that shows you presenting and teaching).

A gift for making complex things simple: You can teach a first-time user and a power user in the same breath, without dumbing anything down.
Fluency in the creator and content world: You understand how people actually make and publish content, and you speak their language.

Bottom line? If you want to take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside is your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your work will genuinely make an impact on a global audience.

We're looking for a User Acquisition Manager to own Search channels end-to-end. You'll run our Google and Bing Search campaigns, build the reporting infrastructure that keeps our growth engine honest, and drive mobile app install efforts, all while finding smart ways to use AI to move faster and scale further. This is a high-autonomy role on a lean, impact-driven team where you'll have direct ownership over a meaningful budget and real business outcomes.
What you'll do:
Search campaign ownership: Full ownership of Google & Bing Search campaigns: optimization, keyword research, bid strategy, ad copy testing, localization, and finding the growth angles that others miss. You'll manage meaningful budgets and be accountable for efficiency and scale, not just activity.
Campaign data operations: Own the reporting infrastructure that the team relies on. Conversion tracking, UTM governance, dashboards, and attribution. Built and maintained in close collaboration with our Data and Marketing Ops teams. When something breaks or numbers don't add up, you're the one who finds out why and helps fix it.
Mobile app install campaigns: Manage and scale app install campaigns across Google and Meta, working with creative and product teams to drive installs and downstream activation.
AI-driven automation & scale: Leverage AI tools to automate repetitive workflows, generate insights faster, and push campaign operations beyond what's possible manually. We're looking for someone who's already using it on a day-to-day basis.
Requirements:
Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Search campaigns (SaaS is advantageous). Someone who's been in the details and knows what it takes to make campaigns perform day to day.
Global scale: Experience running large-scale campaigns across multiple geos and languages. You understand the nuances of localization, regional bidding strategies, and managing performance across diverse markets.
Technical depth: Strong command of conversion tracking, event setup, tag management, and debugging data discrepancies. Comfortable building reports and dashboards from scratch, not just reading them.
AI fluency: A working track record of using AI tools to automate tasks, build reports, or scale campaign operations. We're looking for someone who's already doing this.
Data oriented: You make decisions based on data, you know when a metric is misleading, and you can explain what's happening in a campaign clearly and honestly. Resourceful, self-directed, and wired to move when something breaks or an opportunity opens up.

Senior Backend Platform Engineer
Description
For many of us there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.
Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.
About the Engineering Team
We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical—no overengineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.
On your day to day
As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Platform & Infra Team, you will own the core plumbing of the Riverside ecosystem:
Architecting Scalability: Design and optimize the core processing systems that handle massive concurrency and petabytes of video/audio data.
Driving DevEx: Create the tools, internal platforms, and CI/CD abstractions that empower our product teams to ship code faster and more safely.
GraphQL & API Excellence: Own and optimize our GraphQL layer to ensure seamless, high-performance communication across our microservices.
Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve our AWS environment, focusing on automation, observability, and cost-efficiency.
AI Infrastructure & Agentic Systems: Build and scale the infrastructure powering Riverside’s AI workflows, including MCP integrations and agent-based systems, with a focus on reliability, observability, and real-time orchestration.
Requirements:
What Will Make You Stand Out?
The Experience: 6+ years in backend engineering with a heavy leaning toward infrastructure, platform, or systems design.
The Tech Stack: Expert-level Node.js and TypeScript skills.
API Mastery: Strong experience with GraphQL (schema design, performance, and scaling).
The Data Layer: Deep understanding of MongoDB, Postgres and how to optimize it for high-scale environments.
The Mindset: You are a researcher by nature. You don't just "fix" things; you analyze the system, find the bottleneck, and re-engineer it for the future.
Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

Roche.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
מי אנחנו
רוש היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם, המחויבת לקידום טיפולים חדשניים ו רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, נוירולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה ותחומים תרפויטיים נוספים.
ברוש ישראל אנחנו מתמקדים ברישום, שיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. אנחנו רצים יחד למרחקים ארוכים וגאים לעבוד בסביבה בה קריירה ומשמעות נפגשים. אנחנו מחפשים חברי צוות חדשים שיצטרפו אלינו למסע, בו טובת המטופל היא כוכב הצפון שלנו.
מסגרת התפקיד
מיפוי וזיהוי אתגרים והזדמנויות שעשויים להיטיב עם המטופל במסלול ניהול מחלתו, בתחומים האסטרטגים של רוש
עבודה מול גורמים במערכת הבריאות - קופות החולים, בתי חולים, משרד הבריאות, אקדמיה, מרכזי חדשנות ועוד - בניית קשרים מקצועיים, זיהוי ממשקים לשיתופי פעולה והובלתם
ניהול פרויקטים ושיתופי פעולה להנגשת פתרונות הוליסטיים וחדשניים לקידום הבריאות ושיפור מסע המטופל
חיבור בין מידע רפואי, מיזמים ואנשים באקוסיסטם הבריאות המקומי והגלובלי
מינוף ושיתוף מידע, עבודת צוות מטריציונית בתוך ומחוץ לחברה
דרישות התפקיד
תואר במדעי החיים או מקצועות הבריאות (רפואה, רוקחות, סיעוד וכד')
יתרון לתואר נוסף במינהל מערכות בריאות / מינהל עסקים / תעשייה וניהול
יתרון לניסיון עבודה במערכת הבריאות הציבורית
יכולת לימוד וידע במגוון תחומים תרפויטים, יצירת קשרים מקצועיים לטווח ארוך
ראש יזמי, יצירתיות וזיקה לעולם הבריאות הדיגיטלית והחדשנות
יכולת ניהול עצמי גבוהה, עבודה בצוות מטריציוני והנעת תהליכים
עברית ואנגלית ברמה גבוהה
העבודה באיזור מרכז ודרומה
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Roche.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.
This is a field-based role.
Key Responsibilities:
Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.
Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.
Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.
Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.
Provide scientific documentation to customers.
Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.
Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.
Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.
Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.
Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.
Who you are:
PhD in Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or related field - Mandatory
Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions.
Minimum 3 year of experience in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS).
Fluent in English (oral and written).
Technical vocabulary & terminology.
Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).
Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).
Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.
Verbal and written communication skills.
Planning, administration and decision making.
Work well in a team environment.
Service/Customer oriented.
Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Rockwell Automation.description: Employee Video Spotlight | Rockwell Automation | US Loading Careers --> Employee Video Spotlight The Stories Behind Our People and Our Culture Careers Teams & People Student & Early Careers Students & Early Career Programs Students & Early Career Programs Student Internships & Co-op Programs Student Internships & Co-op Programs Early Career Programs Early Career Programs Supply Chain Careers Employee Spotlight Veterans View Jobs Where you decide to work matters – a lot. You’ve scoured the job boards, combed through Glassdoor, and connected with recruiters on LinkedIn. So, what’s left? Take this time to hear first-hand from the backbones of our company. The employees who wholeheartedly advocate why Rockwell Automation is a great place to grow – and ultimately make your next career move. Paying it Forward – Volunteering with FIRST Erik, Javion, Megan and Meiling – Rockwell employees and FIRST ® volunteers – sat down to discuss their connection to the STEM education organization. Rockwell Automation is a huge presence at FIRST Robotics Competition events – from the technology used on the competition field and the sponsorship of numerous teams to the employees who volunteer as coaches, mentors and judges. Learn more about Rockwell’s commitment to STEM education . 2023 CEO Town Hall Picnic Highlight Reel In September 2023, over 1,500 employees gathered at Rockwell Automation’s Milwaukee headquarters for the CEO Town Hall & Picnic celebration. This special event brought together our CEO and executive leadership team to meet and greet an enthusiastic crowd, share their vision and achievements, and express gratitude and appreciation. This highlight reel features some of the best moments from the event, including a catered lunch, activities and games, and fundraisers supporting the causes of UNCF and United Way. OT Cybersecurity Careers: Together We Are the Shield At Rockwell Automation, we’re growing our expertise in the cybersecurity space – particularly OT cybersecurity, protecting the manufacturing environment for customers across almost every industry. Our employees are proud to build their careers at a global industrial automation and digital transformation leader. Want to learn more about how you could make an impact on your career, our customers and the world at Rockwell? Unlock what’s possible and explore open positions now: rok.auto/cybersecuritycareers. ROK LOK Revival ‘23 Highlights More than 250 employees from across the company came together at the Milwaukee headquarters and virtually for a two-day cybersecurity summit, ROK LOK Revival ’23. Attendees learned from internal and external cybersecurity experts, team-build, and network with colleagues. They share why Rockwell is the perfect place to learn, make an impact and grow a career. Celebrating Difference and Belonging: RAAP ERG In 2013, employees in the Milwaukee area started the Rockwell Automation Asia Pacific (RAAP) employee resource group. The following year, a Cleveland chapter started. Since then, the group has amassed more than 800 members and recently started a new chapter in Canada. RAAP organizes teams to participate in the annual Dragon Boat Races, which are a popular platform for all Rockwell employees to network and build community. A Day in the Life of Women at Rockwell Automation Have you ever wondered what it’s like to work at Rockwell Automation? Women from every region of our global company share how they spend a typical day, whether they work in the office, have a hybrid schedule, or work remotely. Meet Cynthia in China, Sudha in India, Hilit in Israel, Natalia in Argentina, and Sabha, who takes us on a tour of our US headquarters in Milwaukee. On International Women’s Day – and every day – we celebrate and honor our women colleagues around the world. Honoring Black History & Celebrating Community Black History Month 2023 featured educational and celebratory events planned by the African American Professional Network

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer who cares about building high-quality products and turning complex systems into reliable, intuitive solutions.
You’ll work on the core of SOURCIX’s SaaS platform and marketplace, collaborating closely with product, and AI teams. This role is ideal for someone who takes ownership end-to-end: from understanding product requirements, to designing and implementing scalable solutions, and delivering features to production.
You’ll also be expected to operate at the forefront of modern development – leveraging AI tools and rapid, iterative “vibe coding” to move fast and build smarter in a startup environment.

Development & Architecture
Build, maintain, and scale modern web applications across frontend and backend
Design and implement end-to-end features, from UI to backend services

Ensure performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability of the system

Bridge the gap between frontend experience and backend logic
Simplify complex systems into clear and usable solutions
Continuously improve based on feedback and data
Modern Development

Iterate quickly, prototype when needed, and ship production-ready features
Stay at the forefront of AI-driven development and modern engineering practices

Work with APIs, databases, and data flows across the full stack
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions

3+ years of software development experience
Strong experience across both frontend and backend development
Experience with modern web technologies (e.g., React, Next.js, Node.js, or similar)
Good understanding of APIs, databases, and system design
Experience building and integrating production systems end-to-end
Strong attention to detail and code quality
Ability to work independently and take ownership
Nice to Have

Experience with scalable system design and architecture
Experience building SaaS platforms or complex systems
Familiarity with performance optimization across frontend and backend
What We’re Looking For
A builder mindset — someone who moves fast and takes ownership
Strong problem-solving skills

Curiosity and drive to stay at the edge of AI and modern development
Why Join SOURCIX
Join a fast-growing AI startup transforming mechanical procurement and sourcing. We’re building a platform that brings speed, transparency, and intelligence to custom manufacturing – powered by AI and advanced matching algorithms.
Competitive compensation + early-stage equity
Real ownership and impact on product and technology

SOURCIX.description:
The Role
We are looking for a Head of Marketing to lead and execute our marketing strategy across all
channels, with a strong emphasis on B2B growth, ABM (Account-Based Marketing), SaaS
marketing, and AI-driven marketing operations.
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring close collaboration with sales, product, and
leadership teams to shape and communicate our brand story, drive demand generation, and
build the foundation for scalable growth.
Beyond traditional marketing expertise, we are specifically looking for someone who deeply
understands how to leverage AI in modern marketing — both strategically and operationally.
The ideal candidate actively uses AI tools in their personal workflow, understands how AI can
optimize marketing execution and content creation, and can guide teams and external
partners in adopting AI-first marketing methodologies.
The ideal candidate is an experienced B2B marketing leader with a strong track record in
early-stage startups, capable of operating as a highly independent marketing owner while
leveraging agencies, freelancers, and AI tools to scale efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
Own and drive SOURCIX’s short- and long-term marketing strategy — from high-level
positioning to campaign-level execution.
Lead and optimize AI-powered marketing workflows across content creation,
campaign execution, lead generation, research, automation, and analytics.
Drive adoption of AI tools and AI-first methodologies within marketing operations and
collaborate with internal teams to improve efficiency using AI technologies.
Craft compelling messaging and storytelling that clearly communicates SOURCIX’s
value proposition to technical and business audiences.
Define and execute Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for SOURCIX’s SaaS and
Marketplace offerings in alignment with product and sales initiatives.
Plan and execute targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns to generate,
nurture, and convert high-value leads.
Lead demand generation efforts through paid media, outbound campaigns, content
marketing, SEO, email marketing, partnerships, and digital acquisition channels.
Work closely with sales, product, and leadership teams to ensure cohesive messaging,
aligned priorities, and impactful outreach strategies.
Operate effectively as a hands-on marketing leader while identifying opportunities to
scale through agencies, freelancers, automation tools, and future team hires.
Monitor industry trends, customer feedback, AI marketing trends, and competitor
positioning to continuously refine messaging and growth strategy.
Build and manage marketing performance tracking, reporting, and KPI measurement
to support scalable company growth.
Support outbound sales initiatives with personalized marketing content, campaigns,
and sales enablement materials.
Requirements
5–10+ years of experience in B2B marketing with proven success in SaaS and ABM
environments.
Demonstrated experience working in early-stage startups, ideally as the first
marketing hire or as a highly independent marketing lead.
Strong understanding of AI tools and AI-driven marketing workflows.
Personal hands-on use of AI tools for content creation, research, campaign execution,
automation, analytics, or operational workflows.
Ability to guide teams, freelancers, and agencies in adopting AI-powered marketing
processes.
Strong background in positioning technical products to engineering, procurement,
and industrial audiences.
Hands-on experience building and executing GTM campaigns, including marketing
automation and sales enablement workflows.
Exceptional storytelling, branding, content creation, and communication skills.
Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and prioritize
effectively in fast-paced environments.
Fluent English with experience operating in global markets.
Advantages
Background or familiarity with mechanical engineering, manufacturing, procurement,
or industrial sectors.
Experience supporting outbound sales teams through personalized content and
outreach strategies.
Experience working closely with product and development teams to align marketing
with technical roadmaps.
Knowledge of SEO, PPC, paid acquisition, and performance marketing in the B2B
SaaS space.
Experience building AI-native or AI-enhanced marketing operations.
Familiarity with AI content tools, automation platforms, AI agents, and modern AI-assisted growth strategies.
If you are a strategic yet hands-on marketing leader with a passion for storytelling,
technology, AI, and building companies from the ground up — we’d love to hear from you.
Join SOURCIX and help redefine the future of intelligent global sourcing.

We’re looking for a VIP Monetization Manager to join our team in a specialized role focused on Loyalty Feature, aiming to enhance the experience of our games’ most valuable players.
By developing a retention-focused strategy tailored to this key player segment, you’ll drive efforts to strengthen the connection between our games and their high-tier player base, creating an impactful and lasting bond.
In this role, you’ll manage the life cycle of top-tier players, elevating their in-game experience through innovative mechanics and features—driven by data, testing, and evaluation. You’ll work closely with Monetization, Product, and Analytics teams, making data-informed decisions on priorities for both the game team and VIP Account Managers to support the long-term growth of our high-value player tiers. This position offers high-impact potential and a unique blend of creative and analytical skills for the right candidate.

Key responsibilities:
  • Leverage strong numerical and data analysis skills to drive business-oriented decisions, supported by insightful reporting and trend analysis
  • Analyze information effectively, drawing actionable conclusions to optimize player engagement and retention strategies
  • Collaborate with multiple interfaces across the organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to influence outcomes and align goals
  • Demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented approach—able to tackle challenges and drive initiatives forward
  • Exhibit teamwork and a passion for growth, contributing actively to team objectives and culture
  • Communicate clearly and confidently in English, both written and verbal, ensuring ideas and insights are well understood
  • Maintain a focus on consumer behavior, particularly in digital entertainment and gaming, as an advantage

Requirements:
  • Strong skills in numbers, business orientation, reports, and data analysis - a must
  • 2+ Years’ experience as a Product Manager/ Monetization Management in B2C; Gaming, Social/Mobile, Casino preferred
  • Self-motivated and PROACTIVE go-getter who is results-driven and has shown a track record of achievement through creativity – a must!
  • Exemplary communication skills in both written and spoken English – a must

The ideal candidate will be highly detail-oriented and proactive in supporting the team.

  • Prepare and record monthly journal entries for general ledger posting and perform related account reconciliations
  • Assist with the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, working closely with the Finance leadership team
  • Maintain the general ledger accounts for the respective legal entities, reporting discrepancies, imbalances, and other issues to the corporate finance team

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Hebrew
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, unsupervised environment
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously within deadlines in a technology-driven setting
  • Ability to optimize processes and improve workflows
  • Service-oriented with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of personnel
  • Proven problem-solving skills and strong analytical thinking
  • A team player with a proactive approach

  • Serve as the studio’s subject matter expert on monetization, providing strategic guidance and thought leadership across multiple games and products.
  • Partner with game leadership teams to identify monetization opportunities, diagnose complex business challenges, and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Support product, economy, and LiveOps teams in evaluating monetization strategies, pricing approaches, player segmentation, and offer design.
  • Leverage analytics, experimentation results, player behavior insights, and market trends to provide actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
  • Identify cross-portfolio monetization best practices and drive knowledge sharing across game teams.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and monitor industry trends to uncover new opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • Influence decision-making through expertise, insights, and strong stakeholder partnerships while empowering game teams to own and execute their strategies.
  • Develop frameworks, methodologies, and tools that help teams make more effective monetization decisions.
  • Mentor and support product, economy, and monetization professionals across the organization.


Requirements:
  • Significant experience in Monetization, Product, Economy, Growth, or related leadership roles within gaming or a data-driven consumer business.
  • Deep understanding of free-to-play monetization, game economies, LiveOps, and experimentation.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with a proven track record of driving business growth.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
SciPlay.title: VP Monetization

SciPlay.description:
We are looking for a talented and a Monetization Manager to join our team.
The Monetization team is responsible for driving revenue growth and providing the best game experience to our users. To achieve company business goals, the team constantly optimizes the game experience and performance based on data.
As part of your role, you'll manage a full-cycle campaign calendar, including planning short & long-term activities, defining goals, executing, and analyzing performance. Possess a deep understanding of existing game mechanics and how to best utilize them within Monetization tools.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop quarterly, monthly, and weekly promotional plans according to the monetization strategy
  • In charge of the implementation of promotions through the campaign design and creative creation in all communication channels
  • Responsible for the operational launch of campaigns, QA, monitoring results, reacting accordingly, analyzing the campaigns, and bringing insights for optimization
  • Leverage product features and marketing tools for driving revenue growth and providing a good game experience to our players
  • Constantly coming up with exciting new innovative ideas.
  • Constantly improving and optimizing in a data-driven manner the game experience and performance in order to hit the company KPIs.
  • Collaborate with the creative team, operations team, game economy team, BA, and product managers in order to execute in-game events & promotions.
Requirements:
  • 2+ years of experience working as a monetization live-ops/ CRM manager in a gaming company OR 2+ years of experience in a similar role (Product Marketing, Branding, Growth Manager, etc.) in a B2C company.
  • Strong English written/verbal communication skills
  • Outstanding creativity, drive, and data orientation
  • Strong sense of responsibility and professionalism
  • Attention to detail with an eye for aesthetics
  • A people person, positive, initiator, curious, independent, and a quick learner
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work well independently or within a team environment
  • Experience with planning in-app campaign calendar
  • Working closely with all teams in executing in-app promotions (Creative, BA, Product, Economy)
SciPlay.title: Monetization Manager

SciPlay.description:
The Head of Monetization & Economy is responsible for driving the business optimization, monetization models, and game economy strategy across the studio’s portfolio—featuring one live product and two upcoming games in the pre-scale phase. This role is a unique blend of highly analytical business strategy and a deep commitment to the player experience. You will be hands-on in crafting the game economy, while managing and leading the LiveOps and monetization operations functions. By collaborating closely with Product, Creative, and LiveOps teams, you will champion out-of-the-box thinking and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to deliver sustainable growth, compelling in-game campaigns, and an unforgettable player journey.
Key Responsibilities
  • Business & Monetization Strategy: Drive the commercial success of our games by optimizing business models, monetization strategies, and revenue streams, ensuring a balance between high profitability and excellent player retention.
  • Hands-on Economy Design: Take a deeply hands-on approach to building, balancing, and optimizing the game economy and math models. Design the delicate balance of difficulty curves versus reward systems to maximize engagement.
  • Player Experience & Product Collaboration: Share the burden of the overall player experience. Collaborate closely with the Product department to spec features that support monetization, shape the creative direction, and design compelling in-game campaigns and events.
  • LiveOps & Configuration Management: Manage and lead the LiveOps and monetization operations function (including configuration specialists). Oversee the end-to-end execution of events, A/B tests, and economy updates to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Scaling & Launch: Build the foundational economy frameworks for two games currently in the launch/pre-scale phase, driving them from soft launch to successful global scale.
  • Innovation & AI Adoption: Act as a pioneer in adopting new technologies. Leverage AI tools and out-of-the-box thinking to optimize economy balancing, automate workflows, and uncover new monetization opportunities.
  • Data & Experimentation: Analyze player behavior and economy health. Define experimentation strategies and run A/B tests to continuously optimize both business KPIs and player satisfaction.
Requirements
  • Must: 5+ years of experience in Game Economy, Monetization, Product Management, or LiveOps within the gaming industry.
  • Must: Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and balancing complex game economies, math models, and progression systems.
  • Must: Demonstrated experience managing employees and leading operational functions (LiveOps, monetization ops, or configuration teams).
  • Strong understanding of the holistic player experience, including difficulty tuning, reward loops, and the impact of creative assets on player behavior.
  • Strong strategic and business acumen, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business and product decisions.
  • A forward-thinking mindset with a demonstrated passion for exploring and adopting AI tools and innovative tech in day-to-day work.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with Product, R&D, and Creative teams.
  • Advantage: Experience with Ad-driven Free-to-Play business models (Ad-Monetization, Rewarded Video, Interstitials) and mediation platforms.
SciPlay.title: Head of monetization and Economy

SciPlay.description:
SciPlay is looking for a new role in a Head of Production which will be responsible for its industry leading Monopoly Slots Casino game. Experience driving and communicating a clear vision in a highly collaborative environment, managing and mentoring production, and being a true partner to Art, Design, Engineering, Production, and Quality Assurance is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support GM and studio management to drive production initiatives, whether it’s product quality, tech stack, platform integration, feature roadmaps, marketing collaborations or analytics needs.
  • Manage master production plan. Scope and plan feature level tasks, schedules, and task cross discipline teams to execute on time and at high quality.
  • You drive the team to get results and you do so through establishing or maintaining a culture of commitment, accountability, and predictability.
  • You set production goals for your team around performance and quality. You then measure the effectiveness of your team and identify inefficiencies. Based on this analysis, you perform root cause analysis, and other techniques to identify the appropriate corrective actions.
  • You are passionate about project management, pulling from multiple development methodologies, and coaching the production team when to use or adapt each one based on the problems the team is trying to solve.
  • Assist design and product teams to create short-term and long-term live operation plans, including feature and patch release cadences, as well as resource allocations and production processes for efficient quality live services.
  • Keep pulse on team morale and personnel issues. Actively work with leadership team to engage and create positive and inclusive team culture.
  • Identify areas for improvement with production tooling and reporting to assist with monitoring the effectiveness of the team. Keep abreast with the latest software technology to help the team drive forward.
  • Manage short-term and long-term resource and budget plan by working with GM and Finance.

Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience in leading mobile game production pipeline with shipped titles.
  • Experienced in managing production pipeline throughout mobile game lifecycle including live operations.
  • Experienced in co-development relationship with oversea partners.
  • Experienced in working with supporting and service teams such as marketing, legal, finance, creative, HR etc.
  • Excellent leadership, project management, oral and written communication skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Solid organizational skills and highly efficient time management.
  • Keen knowledge of mobile, PC and platform development pipelines as they relate to games and game production.
  • Proficient in people management skills to motivate and grow the team.
  • Strong knowledge of the mobile game market and platforms.
  • International game or business experience.

Key Attributes

  • Strong capability to multitask and prioritize.
  • Unrelenting self-motivation and initiative – comfortable with ambiguity but driven to create structure and order.
  • Absolute passion for playing and making games.

Scylladb.title: Customer Success

Scylladb.description:
About The Position
ScyllaDB is the database behind some of the most demanding, data-intensive applications in the world. Over 300 companies rely on ScyllaDB for their toughest database challenges. When a service needs to handle millions of operations per second with single-digit-millisecond latency, ScyllaDB is what makes it possible.
We're a global, open-culture company with team members across 27 countries, we prioritize collaboration and openness to ensure our users' success. ScyllaDB is available as open source, a fully supported enterprise product, and a fully managed cloud service, and the company continues to grow quickly
You'd be joining our Customer Experience team - currently five people spread across Portugal, the USA, and India. We're now looking for a team member based in Israel, where ScyllaDB has its HQ , putting you right alongside the engineers who build the product. It's a rare seat: close to the technology, close to the customers, and with real influence over both.
﻿The Role:
We're looking for a hands-on Senior Solution Architect to lead our Pre-Sales and Proof-of-Concept work. You'll be the technical authority prospects trust when they're deciding whether to bet their most critical workloads on ScyllaDB and you'll thrive on the pace and ownership that come with a fast-growing company.
Key Responsibilities
Win the technical case. Partner with our sales organization to demonstrate ScyllaDB's value to prospects and drive adoption. You'll own the "technical win" on every opportunity you touch.
Get prospects to production. Provide technical review and recommendations for deploying ScyllaDB in production environments, and help prospects set up, tune, and benchmark the database during Proof-of-Concept phases.
Build and document solutions. Design solutions on ScyllaDB and capture them in clear documentation — including integration guides and benchmarks of third-party tools working alongside our products.
Teach the technology. Develop training materials for ScyllaDB customers, and create and deliver training that helps users get the most out of the platform.
Connect the dots. Collaborate closely with other Solution Architects, and act as the bridge between customers and our product management and engineering teams - carrying real-world feedback back to the people building the product.
Requirements
Pre-Sales / SA experience. 4+ years in a Pre-Sales or Solution Architect role, where you've owned the technical relationship with prospects and earned their trust.
Deep Linux fluency. Excellent working knowledge of Linux operating systems - you're comfortable operating, troubleshooting, and tuning in a Linux environment.
Startup instincts. Experience working in a startup environment, where ambiguity is normal, ownership is high, and moving fast matters.
A feel for selling services. Experience selling DBaaS or other service-oriented products, with an understanding of how technical value translates into a buying decision.
Hands-on NoSQL expertise. 2+ years deploying and managing NoSQL databases (including data modeling and deploying applications on systems like Cassandra/DataStax, MongoDB, or Redis).
Coding ability. A solid command of modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) - enough to build, integrate, and demonstrate, not just discuss.
Big-data ecosystem exposure. Hands-on experience with tools like Spark, Kafka, time-series databases, and graph databases.
A relevant foundation. An undergraduate degree in engineering, computer science, or a similar field.
Outstanding communication. Exceptional written and verbal skills - you can explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers and executives alike.
Apply for this position
