Here's what makes it hard: - Real research is slow. Coding a fair benchmark takes longer than writing an opinion. You do it anyway. - You publish unflattering truths. Sometimes the honest result makes us look worse. You publish it. - You build the rig, not just the prose. The code and data behind a number matter as much as the number. - Ambiguity. As a Design Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for different HW blocks at module-level and sub-system level. You will contribute across a range of technical areas, playing a key role in ensuring high-quality, scalable, and efficient verification solutions.

Experience in unit-level as well as subsystem/full-chip verification.
Experience working on complex ASIC or SOC designs
Experience in Infrastructure Automation with strong proficiency in Python, SCons, MakeFile, git for automated flow generation, regression management and data parsing.
Good knowledge of C/C++ is a plus
System-Level understanding
Experience with SOCs in the communications field – advantage

כן לא יש לבחור תשובה השלמת המועמדות מותנית בעמידה בדרישות התפקיד האם יש לך את הגמישות לבצע מעברים חדים בין פעילות שטח לבין עבודת משרד, תכנון ותיעוד? כן לא יש לבחור תשובה השלמת המועמדות מותנית בעמידה בדרישות התפקיד האם יש ביכולתך לשמר תפקוד מיטבי גם במצבי קיצון, תחת לחץ זמן, חוסר ודאות ועומס משמעותי של משימות? Shahar Hunt.description:
Responsibilities
● Lead strategic planning, execution, and optimization of performance marketing campaigns across Google, Meta (Facebook/IG), TikTok, Taboola, Outbrain and other paid platforms.
● Build, launch, and scale complex campaign structures with a strong focus on performance, ROI, and KPI attainment.
● Design and implement advanced tracking and measurement frameworks, including GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, CAPI, event schemas, and custom attribution setups.
● Conduct sophisticated data analysis to extract actionable insights, inform optimization roadmaps, and guide media strategy.
● Build and test conversion funnels, perform rigorous A/B testing, and refine audiences based on data patterns.
● Use AI/LLM tools to enhance research, predictive analysis, campaign creation, trend identification, and automation workflows.
● Partner closely with internal analytics, creative, and client service teams to ensure alignment between media execution and broader business goals.
● Communicate performance insights, trends, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to internal stakeholders and clients.
Requirments
● 3+ years of experience managing complex eCommerce performance campaigns (Must have experience from a leading agency or a major in-house brand).
● Absolute mastery of Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and Meta Ads, with proven experience managing large-scale budgets and advanced bidding strategies.
● Deep understanding of analytics and tracking—proficient in GA4, GTM, Pixels/CAPI, and understanding complex customer journeys.
● Sharp analytical and business mindset—the ability to read numbers, draw conclusions, and translate them into immediate actions that impact the business.
● High-level verbal and presentation skills (Hebrew and English)—the ability to lead discussions with enterprise clients and build trust.
● Significant Advantage (Game Changer): Hands-on experience with AI tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or automation platforms (Make/Zapier). If you know how to streamline work using AI and turn raw data into automated insights—your place is with us!
You'll stand out from the crowd if:
You’ll stand out from the crowd if
● Professional Development: We prioritize continuous learning through professional courses, advanced skills training, and challenging projects that accelerate your growth and expertise.
● Entrepreneurial Environment: We foster a culture of creative ideas, innovation, and initiative, where your contributions directly influence performance outcomes and the evolution of Hunt.
● Friendly Atmosphere: We offer a pleasant, supportive, and collaborative work environment with excellent conditions, built on teamwork and mutual respect.
● Diverse Projects and Clients: Our varied, performance-driven clientele ensures continuous learning, exposure to new challenges, and professional growth across industries and markets.
● Team Events and Activities: We host team-building activities, company-wide events, and happy hours that strengthen collaboration, culture, and long-term engagement.
We operate in an industry that changes from moment to moment. We are looking for exceptionally professional candidates who are driven to personal development, continuous learning, and embracing challenges without compromise.
This is a full-time, on-site position with the possibility of a hybrid work model after the training period.

Shopcircle.description:
No longer accepting applications
The role
As a Product Manager at Shop Circle, you will own the strategy and execution of one or more products, working closely with engineering, design, data, and business leaders to solve meaningful user problems and deliver scalable, high-impact outcomes.
This role requires strong judgment, clear prioritization, and end-to-end ownership — not just managing backlogs.
What you’ll do
Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap
Build a deep understanding of users and customers through data, feedback, and direct interaction
Translate business objectives into clear product initiatives and priorities
Lead product discovery and delivery from problem definition to measurable impact
Collaborate daily with engineering teams using modern Agile ways of working
Make decisions based on evidence, not assumptions, and continuously validate outcomes
Improve existing features while driving the development of new capabilities
Partner with marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams on go-to-market initiatives
What we’re looking for
3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a SaaS or technology-driven environment, with clear ownership over outcomes
Proven experience working with cross-functional teams
Strong analytical thinking and prioritization skills
Solid understanding of modern product discovery and delivery practices
Clear, structured communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, Productboard, or similar
Fluent English (written and spoken)
Nice to have
Experience working in scale-ups or multi-product organizations
Exposure to post-acquisition or inherited products
Technical background or strong technical intuition
Experience with AI-powered, automation, or data-intensive products
What we offer
Ownership over products with real business and customer impact
High autonomy in how you shape and execute product strategy
Collaboration with experienced international product and engineering teams
Competitive salary and benefits
Flexible hybrid work model based in Sarajevo
A pragmatic, low-ego environment focused on outcomes, not titles
Why Shop Circle
Product Managers at Shop Circle play a direct role in shaping product success and company growth. Your decisions influence customer experience, revenue, and long-term strategy across our portfolio. This is a role for people who value clarity, responsibility, and measurable results.
Ready to build products that scale globally?
Apply now and help shape the next phase of Shop Circle’s growth.

Shopic.description:
We're looking for an experienced and passionate ML Engineering Team Lead to lead our ML Engineering team and shape the next generation of our AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll combine technical leadership, software architecture, and people management to build scalable, production-ready AI systems running on edge devices.
About The Role
Lead, mentor, recruit, and grow a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Own the team's technical roadmap, architecture, execution, and project prioritization, aligning delivery with business goals.
Design, build, and maintain scalable software and ML infrastructure across cloud and edge environments.
Partner with AI Researchers to productionize Computer Vision and Deep Learning models into reliable, high-performance systems.
Design and optimize inference pipelines with a focus on scalability, latency, and reliability.
Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, code reviews, development best practices, and modern AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Your Experience & Skills
6+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering or ML engineering teams.
Strong hands-on experience with Python and C++ or Rust.
Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-grade Machine Learning systems.
Strong understanding of software architecture, scalable system design, and performance optimization.
Experience collaborating with AI, Machine Learning, or Computer Vision teams.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with a strong ownership mindset.
Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex) while maintaining high engineering quality.
Nice to Have
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing AI applications on NVIDIA edge platforms, particularly NVIDIA Jetson devices, including GPU acceleration and deployment on resource-constrained systems.
Experience with modern AI and Computer Vision frameworks such as PyTorch, CUDA, TensorRT, NVIDIA DeepStream, and GStreamer.
Experience with containerized and cloud-native development using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using agentic AI coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and best practices.
Why Join Us?
Build AI products deployed by leading retailers around the world.
Lead a highly technical team working on real-world Edge AI challenges.
Work alongside world-class AI researchers and software engineers.
Influence product direction, architecture and engineering culture.
Solve complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, Computer Vision and retail innovation.

Shopic.description:
As a QA Tech Lead, you will shape QA methodologies, lead the QA team technically, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable systems built on AI, computer vision, and hardware–software integrated solutions . You will thrive in a high-pace, dynamic environment with frequently changing priorities, while maintaining high professional standards and strong cross-team collaboration.
This is a full-time, on-site position (5 days a week from the office) .
About The Role
Perform hands-on manual testing of complex AI-driven and HW-SW integrated systems
Define, implement, and continuously improve QA processes, methodologies, and best practices
Own quality throughout the full product lifecycle, from requirements to production
Plan QA activities based on business and technical priorities, adapting quickly to changing needs
Work closely with all R&D teams
Identify risks, prioritize issues effectively, and ensure timely and high-quality deliveries
Strengthen the company’s quality culture by promoting ownership, accountability, and collaboration
Lead the QA team technically , providing hands-on guidance and setting high standards for quality
Your Experience & Skills
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
Minimum 5+ years of QA experience (mandatory)
2+ years of experience as a Tech Lead/Team Leader
Senior-level QA profile with proven technical leadership capabilities
Experience as a QA Tech Lead or Team Lead (preferred)
Strong background in manual testing of complex systems
Hands-on experience with at least one of the following domains:
AI-based or Computer Vision systems
Hardware- Software solutions
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to distinguish between critical and non-critical tasks
Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
Strong sense of ownership, independence, and accountability
A true team player , and someone who is professional, reliable, and great to work with

Shortical.description:
Description
We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our core team and own the data, reporting, and insight layer that our biggest decisions are built on — what to greenlight, what to spend, and where to double down. You'll report into the Head of Data and work closely with Marketing, Product, and Content, but the core of the job is data work: querying, modeling, dashboarding, and rigorous analysis. As we scale, so will your scope — this is a launchpad role, not a fixed lane.
Responsibilities
Reporting & Dashboards: Own end-to-end reporting — build, maintain, and improve dashboards (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) — and ensure the pipelines feeding them are accurate, timely, and well-documented.
Analysis & Insight Generation: Turn raw data into clear, actionable recommendations by analyzing funnels and attribution, tracking core KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROAS, retention), and proactively surfacing opportunities rather than waiting to be asked.
Data Integration & Engineering: Define and validate tables and data models, define BI events and tracking specs with product and engineering, and work closely with the data engineering team to keep data clean, unified, and query-ready across analytics, ad/campaign, CRM, and product data sources.
Experimentation: Support or run A/B tests across campaigns, product features, or content, applying statistical rigor to test design and readouts.
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex data into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders, and present findings with a structured, problem-first point of view rather than just executing requests as asked.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering/Economics/Statistics, or equivalent degree
4+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL and hands-on experience with BigQuery, Presto, or similar large-scale databases/warehouses.
Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
Experience building tables/data models and defining BI events, ideally in partnership with data engineering.
Experience working with digital data sources (e.g., Google Analytics, ad platforms, CRM systems).
Solid grasp of funnels, attribution modeling, and core performance KPIs.
Able to communicate complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
High attention to detail; structured, problem-solving mindset.
Huge Advantages
Background in mobile / gaming / short-form content or other high-velocity B2C products.
Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, including statistical significance.
Shortical.title: Data Analyst

Shortical.description:
Description
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join us and become the backbone for enabling our data-driven decision-making. This is a high-impact role where you will design and maintain our entire data infrastructure - from raw event ingestion to polished dashboards, empowering Content, Product, and Marketing teams with real-time, actionable insights.
You will own the full data pipeline: modeling, transformation, visualization, and automation.
Responsibilities
Data Pipeline Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from multiple sources into the data warehouse.
Data Modeling: Design and maintain clean, well-documented data models that serve as the single source of truth for the organization.
BI & Analytics: Build and own dashboards, reports, and self-serve analytics tools that provide real-time visibility into KPIs across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization.
Data Quality & Governance: Implement monitoring, alerting, and validation frameworks to ensure data accuracy, freshness, and trust across all pipelines and reports.
Attribution Analytics: Support marketing and growth teams with deep-dive analysis on campaign performance, ROAS, LTV modeling, and attribution across paid and organic channels.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Content, Product, and Marketing teams to translate business questions into data solutions, A/B test analysis, and cohort studies.
Requirements
BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience with designing and building data pipelines, analytical tools, and data warehouses.
Strong Python and SQL skills
Practical experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT workflows using tools such as dbt and Airflow.
Strong proficiency with modern BI platforms (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI) - building dashboards, calculated fields, and self-serve data products.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear data solutions and actionable insights.
Experience working with mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Adjust), product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude), and ad platforms (Meta Ads, Google Ads).
Huge Advantage - industry experience:
Experience analyzing complex in-app purchase economies, subscription funnels, coin/reward systems, and LTV models.
Direct experience with streaming platforms, content performance analytics, or digital media data.
Experience working with Braze, Iterable, or similar CRM/engagement platforms and integrating their data into the warehouse.

Company Overview
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
Position Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated AI Research Student for our Robotics & Simulation AI team. You will be passionate about data science, AI quality measurement, and the intersection of AI with high-accuracy industrial domains. This role is ideal for someone who grows with challenging existing assumptions, defining rigorous evaluation methodologies, and pushing AI systems toward measurable reliability. You will combine strong data science and research skills with hands-on experimentation in a production AI product that controls robotic manufacturing simulations.
Key Responsibilities
AI Quality & Stability Research
Define and implement metrics to measure the stability, accuracy, and reliability of our production AI Copilot (PSCoPilot)
Design evaluation frameworks for AI agents operating in safety-critical robotics and simulation environments
Build observability and tracing pipelines using platforms like Langfuse to monitor Copilot performance, token usage, latency, and tool-calling success rates
Analyze failure modes, hallucination patterns, and tool-calling accuracy across 48+ MCP-exposed robotic operations
Develop automated regression and benchmark pipelines to track Copilot quality over time
Data Science & Experimentation
Conduct statistical analysis on Copilot interactions (tool selection accuracy, collision detection correctness, path planning success rates)
Research and apply techniques from AI evaluation literature (LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop validation, domain-specific benchmarks)
Leverage LangChain and similar orchestration frameworks to prototype evaluation chains, structured agent workflows, and comparison experiments
Explore how multi-layer agent architectures (fast triage + deep execution) affect accuracy and cost trade-offs
Challenge the team with data-driven insights on where the Copilot underperforms and why
Domain AI Research
Investigate how to improve AI reasoning for robotics tasks requiring high precision (welding, clearance checking, reachability analysis)
Research grounding techniques that reduce errors in domains with zero tolerance for incorrect outputs
Explore and apply new AI technologies (GenAI tools, AI coding assistants, agents, MCP-based solutions) to enhance Copilot capabilities
Validate technical feasibility through hands-on experimentation with our production MCP bridge and two-layer streaming agent engine
Communication & Documentation
Document findings, benchmarks, and technical recommendations
Present results to technical and business partners
Collaborate with the team to translate research insights into production improvements
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Master's degree or equivalent experience in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field with minimum 2 years until graduation
Strong background in data science, statistical analysis, and experiment design
Proficiency in Python with experience using LLM orchestration platforms (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI)
Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, prompt engineering, or AI agent architectures
Experience with or strong interest in defining quality metrics for AI systems
Fast learner with strong self-motivation and ability to challenge technical decisions with data
Proficiency in English
Preferred
Experience with AI observability platforms (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar)
Exposure to robotics, simulation, manufacturing, or safety-critical AI domains
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI coding assistants, or multi-agent systems
Why Us
We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Compensation
The hourly rate for this position is ILS 90 per hour for students pursuing a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience during their first year of employment with Siemens. Starting from their second year of employment, students pursuing a bachelor's degree will receive ILS 100 per hour. Students pursuing a master's degree or equivalent experience will receive ILS 100 per hour.

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our cutting-edge tools empower companies worldwide to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers leverage our solutions to push the boundaries of technology and physics, delivering superior products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.
We are seeking a talented Corporate Application Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will provide essential technical support to our customers utilizing our Tessent Design-For-Test (DFT) products. You will also be responsible for delivering product instruction to both our customers and internal field personnel. This position offers a unique opportunity to deepen your understanding of advanced DFT techniques and their application in various IC designs across industries such as AI, Automotive, Cellular Phones, and many more.
Key Responsibilities:
As a Corporate Application Engineer, your role will involve:
Staying current with the latest advancements in Scan Insertion, ATPG, BIST, and Diagnosis tools.
Collaborating with our Application Engineers and customers worldwide to resolve complex technical DFT issues.
Developing and delivering best-in-class product and flow support for DFT.
Readiness for occasional business travel (less than 10% of working time).
Qualifications:
To succeed in this role, you should possess:
A Bachelor's (BSEE) or Master's (MSEE) degree in Electrical Engineering, with a Master's degree being preferred.
At least two years of experience in IC/VLSI design, specifically in IC/VLSI testing and design for testability.
Preferred experience includes design, simulation, and verification of IC/VLSI circuits and systems, design verification, and product test generation.
An in-depth understanding of Design for Test (DFT) structures is required.
Knowledge of Scan Data Compression methodologies and ATPG flows and/or MemoryBIST Flows is highly desired.
Experience with CAD tools such as Synthesis, Simulation, ATPG, Memory BIST, Logic BIST, and Boundary Scan.
Strong troubleshooting skills are essential.
Excellent interpersonal communication skills and customer-facing skills are a must.
Preferred Experience in Specific Areas:
UNIX, Linux.
Verilog (Behavioral, RTL, gate level), System Verilog, VHDL (Behavioral, RTL, gate level), TCL.

Company Overview
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
Position Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated AI Research Student for our Robotics & Simulation AI team. You will be passionate about data science, AI quality measurement, and the intersection of AI with high-accuracy industrial domains. This role is ideal for someone who grows with challenging existing assumptions, defining rigorous evaluation methodologies, and pushing AI systems toward measurable reliability. You will combine strong data science and research skills with hands-on experimentation in a production AI product that controls robotic manufacturing simulations.
Key Responsibilities
AI Quality & Stability Research
Define and implement metrics to measure the stability, accuracy, and reliability of our production AI Copilot (PSCoPilot)
Design evaluation frameworks for AI agents operating in safety-critical robotics and simulation environments
Build observability and tracing pipelines using platforms like Langfuse to monitor Copilot performance, token usage, latency, and tool-calling success rates
Analyze failure modes, hallucination patterns, and tool-calling accuracy across 48+ MCP-exposed robotic operations
Develop automated regression and benchmark pipelines to track Copilot quality over time
Data Science & Experimentation
Conduct statistical analysis on Copilot interactions (tool selection accuracy, collision detection correctness, path planning success rates)
Research and apply techniques from AI evaluation literature (LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop validation, domain-specific benchmarks)
Leverage LangChain and similar orchestration frameworks to prototype evaluation chains, structured agent workflows, and comparison experiments
Explore how multi-layer agent architectures (fast triage + deep execution) affect accuracy and cost trade-offs
Challenge the team with data-driven insights on where the Copilot underperforms and why
Domain AI Research
Investigate how to improve AI reasoning for robotics tasks requiring high precision (welding, clearance checking, reachability analysis)
Research grounding techniques that reduce errors in domains with zero tolerance for incorrect outputs
Explore and apply new AI technologies (GenAI tools, AI coding assistants, agents, MCP-based solutions) to enhance Copilot capabilities
Validate technical feasibility through hands-on experimentation with our production MCP bridge and two-layer streaming agent engine
Communication & Documentation
Document findings, benchmarks, and technical recommendations
Present results to technical and business partners
Collaborate with the team to translate research insights into production improvements
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Master's degree or equivalent experience in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field with minimum 2 years until graduation
Strong background in data science, statistical analysis, and experiment design
Proficiency in Python with experience using LLM orchestration platforms (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI)
Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, prompt engineering, or AI agent architectures
Experience with or strong interest in defining quality metrics for AI systems
Fast learner with strong self-motivation and ability to challenge technical decisions with data
Proficiency in English
Preferred
Experience with AI observability platforms (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar)
Exposure to robotics, simulation, manufacturing, or safety-critical AI domains
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI coding assistants, or multi-agent systems

About the Role
You will own the player economy across our RMG and Sweepstakes brands: bonuses, offers, VIP and loyalty, GC/SC coin packages and pricing, segmentation, economy-driven features, game RTP and content mix. You set the economic rules, measure the outcomes and adjust.
You will work across Product, CRM, VIP, User Acquisition, Analytics, Casino, Customer Service and Marketing so every team operates against one economic and monetization plan.
What You Will Do
Define monetization and economy strategy by vertical, brand and player segment: bonus cost as a share of GGR, promotional depth, VIP reinvestment, pricing and RTP policy.
Own the bonus and offer framework: mechanics, eligibility, cost models, wagering/playthrough rules and abuse controls.
Own player segmentation and lifecycle monetization across new, active, retained, lapsing, reactivated, high-value and VIP players.
Design and price GC/SC coin packages, bundles, first-purchase/first-deposit offers and personalized offers.
Own VIP and loyalty economics: tier thresholds, reinvestment rates, rewards and cost per tier; automatically control spend on negative-value players.
Approve the economics of promotions proposed by CRM, VIP, Customer Service and Marketing and hold teams accountable to the plan.
Set RTP policy by brand, market and game category, and manage game/provider mix against margin and retention targets.
Define economic requirements for features including bonus engines, gamification, missions, tournaments, jackpots, cashback and loyalty.
Own A/B testing across pricing, bonus depth, packages, rewards, promotions and economy features; scale what works and stop what does not.
Forecast the impact of changes before release and report actual performance against forecast after launch.
Define economy and monetization dashboards with Analytics and run a regular economy review with leadership.
Work with Compliance to ensure bonus terms, RTP disclosure and promotional mechanics remain within the rules of each market.
What You Bring
5+ years in Monetization, Game Economy, LiveOps, Product or Revenue Optimization within iGaming, Sweepstakes, Social Casino or highly monetized F2P gaming.
Direct ownership of bonus, promotional, economy or VIP reinvestment budgets, with measurable results you can demonstrate.
Proven ability to improve revenue, payer/depositor conversion, retention, ARPPU and player LTV.
Working knowledge of slot mechanics, RTP models, volatility, bonus abuse patterns and wagering/playthrough design.
Understanding of dual-currency Sweepstakes economies: Gold Coins / Sweepstakes Coins, purchases, promotional currency, playthrough and redemption.
Strong analytical skills: able to build cost models and independently interpret cohort, segmentation and LTV data.
Track record of controlled experimentation and changing commercial decisions based on evidence.
Leadership experience and the ability to challenge commercial teams and explain economics in clear business language.
Strong advantages: direct US Sweepstakes experience, operator-side experience with CRM/bonus engine platforms, multi-brand experience, RMG casino experience, SQL/BI capability and experience building or leading monetization/economy teams.
How Success is Measured
Bonus and promotional cost as a share of GGR within target by vertical, brand and segment.
Effective RTP and margin within policy while protecting retention and player value.
VIP reinvestment proportional to player value and profitability.
Improvement in second purchase / second deposit rates, payer conversion, ARPPU, retention and LTV.
Incremental revenue from A/B tests, new features, pricing and segmentation without costs growing faster than revenue.
The Offer
We are prepared to pay at the top of the market for exceptional talent.
High executive-level base salary
Significant performance-based bonus
Meaningful equity participation
Long-term incentives linked to the value you help create
Real ownership, direct access to senior management and significant decision-making authority
We are not looking for someone to simply manage an existing function. We want someone who can build it, own it, materially grow the business and participate in the upside they create.
About sixvalues
Our vision is to elevate the mood of people everywhere, making every interaction more engaging, rewarding, and memorable. Through cutting-edge technology and a real commitment to excellence, we aim to revolutionize how people connect with digital experiences, transforming the world of betting and gaming technology.
Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to be a fast-moving, highly efficient tech company that brings joy and excitement to players by delivering top-tier solutions for operators. From website and application development to data analytics and payment systems, everything we do is designed to create seamless, thrilling experiences for our partners and their customers.

By using KPIs like organic traffic, search rankings, and click-through rates, you’ll evaluate the success of SEO campaigns and ensure strategies are executed on time and within budget. Additionally, you’ll optimize web content, paid search ads, and landing pages based on data-driven insights, while continuously reviewing and improving existing content to meet SEO best practices.
What You’ll Do
As a Head of SEO you will lead and manage a team of SEO team leads and specialists, ensuring the successful execution of both on-site and off-site SEO strategies. You will be responsible for researching market trends and keywords to develop effective content strategies, as well as setting measurable SEO targets. About The Position
Who are we?
Skai (formerly Kenshoo) is a leading omnichannel marketing platform that leverages advanced AI and data-driven performance media to enable smarter decision-making, increased efficiency, and maximized ROI for businesses worldwide. Our platform helps manage approximately $10B in annual ad spend through partnerships with Google, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, and others.
Founded in 2006, Skai is a global company operating in a hybrid work model that combines remote flexibility with in-office collaboration. We continuously modernize our stack to handle commerce decisions at a massive global scale.
What will you do?
As the Data Infrastructure Lead, you will own the technical direction, architecture, and delivery of Skai’s core production data infrastructure (MySQL, SingleStore, Snowflake, Airflow, and Microservices).
In this role, you will balance in-house, open-source, and SaaS solutions to manage petabyte-scale data while ensuring system reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency. You will blend hands-on engineering, technical architecture, vendor management, and team mentorship. You will lead cross-functional delivery, drive operational excellence across a 24/7 production environment, and set engineering guardrails for cloud-based data systems across the company.
Responsibilities:
Technical Leadership & Architecture : Set engineering guardrails, lead architectural reviews, lead the pod’s daily, and balance design tradeoffs for cloud-based data systems across all business units.
Execution & Delivery : Own the pod’s Scrum processes (epics, stories, tracking), balance technical debt management with rapid feature delivery, and drive multi-project execution.
Hands-on Engineering & Escalations: Stay active in code and infrastructure, serving as the primary technical escalation point for complex, 24/7 production issues.
Ops, High Availability & Reliability: Oversee operational readiness, rotation schedules, high availability (HA), backup and recovery processes, and automation to maintain 24/7 production uptime.
Mentorship & Team Culture : Raise the technical bar, foster a culture of engineering excellence, mentor team members, and drive professional growth within the pod.
Stakeholder & Vendor Alignment: Act as a strategic partner to align roadmap planning, bridge technical execution with business goals, and serve as the main point of contact for data infrastructure vendors.
Requirements
5+ years of proven experience in a DBA, DevOps, DataOps, or Data Engineering role with deep hands-on ownership of production databases (e.g., MySQL, SingleStore, PostgreSQL).
Proven track record in designing, operating, and maintaining large-scale data infrastructure (capacity planning, performance tuning and upgrades, monitoring, CI/CD (Jenkins/GHA/ArgoCD)).
Strong software engineering capabilities in Python, Java, or Go within a microservices architecture, as well as Bash scripting.
Hands-on expertise with Linux environments and at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred).
Demonstrated experience in leading technical design reviews, setting engineering guardrails, and mentoring engineers.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a data-informed approach to resolving complex, cross-system production issues in a 24/7 environment.
Exceptional communication, teamwork, and stakeholder management skills.
Advantages:
Experience with modern Big Data technologies at scale (e.g., Snowflake, Kafka, Spark).
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible.
Previous experience as a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or Acting Lead on a mission-critical production team.
Working with AI tools / integrating AI into engineering and operational workflows.

Description
As BMC System Engineer, you will design the command-and-control architecture: requirements, interfaces, integration, and validation across sensors, interceptors, and operator systems. You will work directly with R&D, software, and hardware teams, taking systems from architecture through live field trials. This role suits engineers who have been close to operational military systems and know how to close the loop between the whiteboard and the field.
Why Join Skapion?
Skapion is a stealth defense-tech company, founded by an experienced and successful leadership team. We are funded by top-tier backers from the US, Israel, and Europe, and are recruiting at full steam. The first challenge we're focusing on is one of the world's most urgent defense concerns.
Responsibilities
Design and develop the battle management system: threat tracking, engagement sequencing, and intercept coordination.
Author system requirements (SSS, SSDD) and ICDs across BMC interfaces.
Drive lab and field integration across sensors, interceptors, and C2 nodes.
Plan and execute system-level tests, field trials, and post-trial data analysis.
Support customer deliveries and operational readiness milestones.
Work across teams to ensure the BMC layer meets performance, reliability, and safety requirements.
Requirements
Engineering degree or equivalent exact sciences background - MUST. M.Sc. in Systems Engineering or a related field - an advantage.
Experience with command and control or battle management systems in the IDF or defense industry (air defense, fire control, C2 operator, or equivalent Background).
Proven hands-on development of control or BMC-type systems, from architecture through field validation.
Experience with Kalman filtering or state estimation - an advantage.
Proficiency in Python or MATLAB - an advantage.
Hands-on integration experience: lab setup, field trials, and data decoding and analysis - an advantage.
Requirements authoring using formal tools (SSS, SSDD or equivalent) - an advantage.
System acceptance and delivery experience for operational customers - an advantage.
Active security clearance (advantage) - an advantage.

Description
As the Software Group Lead, you will be the primary architect and execution lead for a cutting-edge missile interceptor system. This is a high-stakes executive role requiring a rare blend of low-latency embedded engineering and high-level Command & Control (C2) orchestration. You will be responsible for building a multi-disciplinary software team from the ground up, defining the software lifecycle, and ensuring the seamless integration of missile subassemblies with ground-based mission control.
We are looking for a "builder" mentality, capable of switching between high-level architectural strategy and driving end-to-end delivery from concept to field deployment.
Why Join Skapion?
This is a unique opportunity to be at the heart of a defense-tech startup during its most exciting growth phase!
The SW Group Lead will report directly to the CTO and act as a member of the company's leadership.
Responsibilities
Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and manage a high-performance team of embedded, full-stack, and GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) engineers.
System Architecture: Design the end-to-end software stack, from real-time operating systems (RTOS) on the interceptor to the distributed microservices of the ground station.
Execution & Integration: Oversee the development of flight software, sensor fusion algorithms, and secure communication protocols between the interceptor and C2.
AI-Driven SDLC: Implement and champion the use of modern AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) across the entire software lifecycle to accelerate development cycles without compromising safety-critical standards.
Strategic Oversight: Align software milestones with hardware integration, testing phases (HIL/SIL), and field trials.
Key Interfaces: Works closely with Hardware Engineering leads (mechanical, electrical, GNC), Program Management, and Systems Engineering teams internally; externally interfaces with defense customers, government program offices, and key technology vendors.
Requirements
Embedded & Flight Systems
Expertise in C/C++ for hard real-time environments.
Deep experience with RTOS .
Understanding of subcomponent algorithms and implementation in embedded HW.
Hands-on experience with communication bus protocols: CAN bus, MIL-STD-1553, SPI, and Ethernet .
Ground Station & C2 (Command and Control)
Architecture of distributed systems for mission monitoring and threat evaluation.
Implementation of low-latency data visualization and geospatial situational awareness.
Expertise in secure, jam-resistant RF data links and network protocols.
Experience deploying distributed systems on containerized environments ( Kubernetes, Docker ) for scalable mission-critical workloads.
Modern AI & Software Tooling
AI Mastery: Proven track record of adopting AI agentic tools to modernize legacy systems, document complex architectures, and create a rapid delivery environment.
DevOps for Defense: Implementation of CI/CD pipelines tailored for embedded systems, including automated Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
System-Level Integration
Experience with Sensor Fusion (Radar, EO/IR, IMU) and target tracking.
Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks for defense-grade software (e.g., MISRA C/C++).
Qualifications
Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role within the aerospace, defense, or robotics sectors.
Project History: Direct experience in the development of UAVs, missiles, or autonomous kinetic systems.
Education: B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.

Additional languages relevant to global supplier communication.

Skapion.description:
Description
Hands-on software engineering for our cutting-edge missile interceptor system. You'll develop and integrate components across the software stack, either on the embedded / flight side (RTOS, low-latency sensor and comm code on the interceptor) or on the ground station / Command & Control side (distributed services for mission monitoring, threat evaluation, and visualization). You'll work under the Software Group Lead's architectural direction, with deep ownership of the modules you ship.
We are looking for a "builder" mentality, someone who drives end-to-end delivery from concept to field deployment, and who treats AI coding tools as a force multiplier rather than a curiosity.
Why Join Skapion?
This is a unique opportunity to be at the heart of a defense-tech startup during its most exciting growth phase!
Responsibilities
Build: Develop flight software, sensor fusion algorithms, and secure communication protocols between the interceptor and C2; or build distributed microservices for the ground station, depending on which area fits your background.
Integrate: Work alongside Hardware Engineering (mechanical, electrical, GNC), Systems Engineering, and Program Management to integrate the software with the rest of the missile and ground station.
Test: Participate in HIL/SIL testing phases, support field trials, and write the automation that keeps these tests fast and reliable.
AI-assisted delivery: Use modern AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) heavily across your daily work to ship faster without compromising safety-critical standards.
Collaborate: Contribute to design reviews and architectural decisions; raise issues and propose alternatives rather than waiting for direction.
Requirements
Experience: 3-5+ years in software engineering, ideally with exposure to aerospace, defense, robotics, or another safety-critical domain.
Strong in C/C++ for hard real-time environments, OR strong in distributed/back-end stacks (Go, Rust, Python, Node) for the ground-station side.
One or more of these depending on your specialization:
RTOS experience (FreeRTOS, VxWorks, embedded Linux, etc.)
Communication bus protocols: CAN bus, MIL-STD-1553, SPI, Ethernet
Distributed systems on containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker)
Low-latency data visualization and geospatial situational awareness
Education: B.Sc. in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
Project history: Direct experience contributing to UAVs, missiles, autonomous kinetic systems, or similar safety-critical hardware/software systems.
Eligible for security clearance.
Preferred Qualifications
AI tooling fluency: Proven track record of using AI agentic tools to ship faster, refactoring legacy systems, documenting complex architectures, generating tests.
DevOps for embedded: Experience building CI/CD pipelines for embedded systems, including automated Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
Sensor fusion (Radar, EO/IR, IMU) and target tracking experience.
Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks for defense-grade software (e.g., MISRA C/C++).
Experience with secure, jam-resistant RF data links and network protocols.
M.Sc. in a relevant field.

Soliduslabs.description:
The Role
We're looking for a Head of Data to lead our Tel Aviv-based Data organization — spanning Data Infrastructure, Data Applications, and Data Adapters/Integration. This is a group-lead role: you will own the org's technical direction and delivery end to end, manage a group of Tech Leads and Staff Engineers (not just individual contributors), and be the single accountable owner for how Solidus ingests, stores, serves, and scales data across billions of events a day.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend real time in code, architecture reviews, and incident debugging — not just in planning meetings — and you'll be expected to be physically present and available as the standard for how the org operates.
What you'll own
Org leadership — manage and grow the Tech Leads and Staff Engineers running Data Infrastructure, Data Applications, and Data Adapters; set technical direction, hiring plans, and career paths for the group.
Scale and reliability — guide decisions on our ClickHouse, Kafka, Airflow, and K8s-based pipelines processing billions of events a day across real-time and T+1 batch workloads; own migrations and technical-debt paydown (e.g., decommissioning legacy systems) with a concrete, tracked plan.
End-to-end technical accountability — own architecture and detailed design decisions across the data stack; personally review critical PRs and lead debugging on high-severity production issues rather than delegating and disengaging.
Delivery and quality — drive sprint delivery, on-call health, testing rigor, and code-review discipline across all three teams; be the last line of defense against regressions and breaking changes reaching production.
Cross-functional and external representation — partner with Product, Compliance, Customer Success, and clients on integrations and data quality; represent the Data org professionally and constructively in stakeholder-facing conversations, including under pressure.
Team development — mentor and coach Tech Leads and engineers, give and receive feedback directly and without defensiveness, and build clear upward paths for high performers.
What we're looking for
8+ years of backend/data engineering experience, including 3+ years managing multiple teams or leading through Tech Leads/Staff Engineers (not just individual contributors).
Genuinely hands-on: Read and review code, help debug production issues personally, and go deep on a system rather than relying on secondhand summaries.
Experience with high-throughput, low-latency data systems at scale: streaming (Kafka or similar), analytical stores (ClickHouse, Snowflake, or similar), orchestration (Airflow), and containerized microservices (K8s).
Strong SQL and query optimization experience; comfort owning schema versioning, data governance, and deduplication strategy at scale.
Proven track record of end-to-end ownership — architecture through implementation through operational health — with a demonstrated habit of catching issues (code review, testing, monitoring) before they reach production.
Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar) and owning operational SLAs.
Demonstrated reliability and availability as a leadership default — consistent, predictable presence; transparent, advance planning of time off/travel rather than after-the-fact notice.
Clear, professional written and verbal communication with both engineering and non-engineering/external stakeholders, including a demonstrated pattern of incorporating critical feedback without defensiveness.
AI fist: coding tools/harnesses as part of a modern engineering workflow.
Domain experience in fintech, trading, or crypto compliance/surveillance.
Experience integrating third-party/customer data sources or leading vendor-facing technical relationships.
Tech Stack
Java, Kafka, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes, Redis, AWS, Prometheus/Grafana.
Why this role
You'll build and run a multi-team data organization from a position of real technical ownership — not managing status updates, but setting direction for the systems that process over a trillion events a day, with a mandate to raise the bar on rigor, reliability, and how the org shows up for its stakeholders.

Soliduslabs.description:
The Role
We’re looking for a strong Software Engineer with experience in Data Engineering. Someone who is proficient in building robust, scalable, maintainable, and thoroughly monitored data pipelines on cloud environments.
As an ambitious start-up in an extremely dynamic space, we pride ourselves on being independent, accountable, and organized, with a self-starter attitude and a willingness to get our hands dirty with day-to-day work that might fall outside our official scope, while keeping an eye on our goals and the big picture.
Responsibilities:
Design and optimize the ClickHouse data layer - including table engines, partition strategies, materialized views, and storage policies - to ensure high performance at billions-of-events scale.
Own ClickHouse clusters sizing, topology decisions, and capacity planning across both real-time ingestion and T+1 batch workloads, balancing cost, latency, and throughput.
Drive data reliability and deduplication strategies within ClickHouse, leveraging engine-level features (ReplacingMergeTree, CollapsingMergeTree, etc.) and pipeline-level controls to guarantee data completeness and consistency.
Establish and continuously improve monitoring, alerting, and observability for the ClickHouse layer — covering replication health, merge performance, query latency, and resource utilization.
Serve as the internal ClickHouse authority, coaching engineering teams across the organization on query optimization, data modeling best practices, and efficient use of ClickHouse-specific constructs.
Act as the primary liaison with the ClickHouse vendor team - triaging issues, incorporating product feedback, evaluating new features, and translating vendor guidance into actionable improvements for our deployment.
Collaborate with downstream consumers (analytics, ML, product) to understand access patterns and continuously refine how data is stored and served — improving query performance, schema design, and data formats for diverse client needs.
Define and enforce schema versioning and governance standards within the ClickHouse environment, ensuring schema evolution does not compromise pipeline reliability or consumer compatibility.
BSc. in Computer Sciences.
Strong background as a software engineer with at least 5+ years of hands-on experience with Java, Rust, or Python.
8+ years in data engineering and data pipeline development on high-volume, low-latency production environments.
Experience working in low-latency, real-time systems processing billions of events a day.
Deep, hands-on ClickHouse expertise - including cluster architecture, table engine selection, replication, sharding, and query optimization. Experience engaging with the ClickHouse vendor team or community is a strong plus.
Proficiency across the broader data engineering stack: Apache Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Kubernetes, Redis, Snowflake, and caching technologies.
Expert-level SQL and query optimization skills, with a strong emphasis on ClickHouse-specific patterns - materialized views, projections, TTLs, and merge tree tuning.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar), with the ability to define and own operational health metrics for a ClickHouse deployment.
Curiosity, ability to work independently, and a track record of proactively identifying and driving solutions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to coach and influence engineers across teams in a remote environment.

Israel
Algorithm team Leader (R&D)
Caesarea
Spectrum Dynamics Medical is engaged in the development, manufacturing, sale and service of state-of-the-art nuclear medicine imaging systems.
We are spearheading the transformation of the Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography imaging systems from analog to digital detection technology, enabling hospitals and clinicians to provide superior healthcare services at much lower cost.
We launched the world first digital cardiac dedicated SPECT system – the D-SPECT® Cardio system – in 2007. Since then, the D-SPECT® has become the system of choice for functional cardiac imaging with hundreds of systems sold worldwide. The D-SPECT® employs digital detectors made of Cadmium Zinc Telluride (“CZT”), which along with ingenious hardware design, proprietary software and proprietary algorithms, enables imaging of cardiac patients at unprecedented speed, at a low radiation dose, and with superior image quality. The D-SPECT® is a platform for next generation imaging, and therapy guiding cardiac applications.
Recently we launched its multipurpose SPECT and SPECT-CT systems – the VERITON® and the VERITON-CT® – the VERITON® systems employ digital CZT detectors mounted on 12 robotic arms arranged at 360° around the patient. They are integrated with innovative hardware and software design that enables users to image multiple organs (brain, thyroid, cardiac, lungs, bones etc.) at high speed, low radiation dose, and with significant improvement in image quality. The VERITON-CT® system includes a high speed, low dose, 16 or 64 slice CT, which is upgradable to 128 slices. The VERITON-CT® provides best in class combined functional and anatomic images.
Position Responsibilities
Lead and mentor a team of algorithm and AI developers, fostering growth in AI, machine learning, and deep learning skills,
Definition of system algorithms. – Oversee the design, development, and validation of advanced algorithms for medical imaging, with a focus on AI-driven solutions.
Collaborate closely with core teams – software, physics, and clinical to integrate AI algorithms into multidisciplinary medical imaging systems.
Drive innovation in image processing, reconstruction, and quantitative analysis using state-of-the-art AI techniques.
Support timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation to ensure successful execution of R&D objectives, Aligning team skills with project needs and organizational goals.
Prepare and support related technical documentation, and regulatory support materials for AI-based solutions.
Experiences, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Advanced degree (PhD / Master’s) in AI/ML, image processing, or related fields.
5+ years of hands-on development experience in industry or academia (mandatory).
Strong expertise in AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch or other.
Experience in Python and/or MATLAB (mandatory); C++/.NET is an advantage.
Experience in NM/CT or similar medical imaging domains (mandatory).
Familiarity with regulated medical device environments (FDA, MDR) is an advantage.
Understanding AI ethics, governance, and responsible AI practices.
Strong cross-functional leadership and communication abilities.
Commitment to continuous learning and innovation in AI-driven imaging.

Stigg.description:
Stigg
The Usage Runtime for AI Products
But what is it exactly?
Built by former New Relic engineers, Stigg provides the infrastructure AI companies need to meter, monetize, and govern product usage at scale.
Our real-time usage runtime enables companies to manage entitlements, usage metering, credits, budgets, and access controls - all without building complex infrastructure from scratch.
So what? Why now?
AI is fundamentally changing how software is consumed and monetized. Every API request, inference, or agent action can generate real cost, while traditional billing systems only report usage after it happens.
Stigg helps AI companies make real-time decisions about what each customer, user, team, or agent is allowed to do - before the cost is incurred. This gives engineering teams the control they need, while allowing Product and GTM teams to quickly introduce and evolve new monetization models.
Are you funded? 💰
We are! Stigg is backed by Red Dot Capital Partners, Unusual Ventures, and Emerge. Our platform is trusted by leading companies such as Miro, Webflow, PagerDuty, Upwork, Productboard, Qlik, and HackerOne.
Team → Product → Traction - where you at?
🐜 A lean global team of around 40 people
🏠 Headquartered in Tel Aviv, with team members across Israel, the US, and Europe
🚀 Launched Stigg 2.0 - the Usage Runtime for AI Products
⚡ Built to process over 1M usage events per second and make real-time decisions in milliseconds

Stigg.description:
Stigg
The Usage Runtime for AI Products
But what is it exactly?
Built by former New Relic engineers, Stigg provides the infrastructure AI companies need to meter, monetize, and govern product usage at scale.
Our real-time usage runtime enables companies to manage entitlements, usage metering, credits, budgets, and access controls - all without building complex infrastructure from scratch.
So what? Why now?
AI is fundamentally changing how software is consumed and monetized. Every API request, inference, or agent action can generate real cost, while traditional billing systems only report usage after it happens.
Stigg helps AI companies make real-time decisions about what each customer, user, team, or agent is allowed to do - before the cost is incurred. This gives engineering teams the control they need, while allowing Product and GTM teams to quickly introduce and evolve new monetization models.
Are you funded? 💰
We are! Stigg is backed by Red Dot Capital Partners, Unusual Ventures, and Emerge. Our platform is trusted by leading companies such as Miro, Webflow, PagerDuty, Upwork, Productboard, Qlik, and HackerOne.
Team → Product → Traction - where you at?
🐜 A lean global team of around 40 people
🏠 Headquartered in Tel Aviv, with team members across Israel, the US, and Europe
🚀 Launched Stigg 2.0 - the Usage Runtime for AI Products
⚡ Built to process over 1M usage events per second and make real-time decisions in milliseconds

Surecomp.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, proactive, and commercially minded Sales Operations Manager to support Surecomp's global commercial organization and work closely with our senior leadership team.
We are looking for someone who understands how sales organizations work, knows how to turn data into insights, and is eager to be in the middle of the action rather than on the sidelines of it. You will own the operational engine of our global sales organization, from Salesforce governance and pipeline visibility through to forecasting, reporting, and commercial analysis, while working closely with senior leadership to translate insights into action.
The right person for this role has a Sales Operations foundation and the mindset to go beyond it. Someone who takes ownership naturally, moves fast, thinks commercially, and uses AI and modern tools not because they have to but because they want to, proactive by nature, not because someone asked to be, and due to the excitement it brings.
This is a hybrid position based out of our Kfar Saba office, supporting a global commercial organization across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and North America.
Roles and Responsibilities
Own and continuously improve global Sales Operations processes, reporting, and governance across the commercial organization.
Build, maintain, and optimize Salesforce dashboards, pipeline reports, data quality frameworks, and sales performance metrics.
Support the CRO and commercial leadership with forecasting, pipeline analysis, and business performance reviews.
Identify revenue risks, pipeline gaps, and growth opportunities through structured data analysis and commercial thinking.
Partner with regional sales teams to improve CRM adoption, opportunity management, and process discipline.
Support the preparation and execution of business reviews, including analysis, executive presentations, and follow-up tracking.
Work closely with senior leadership to translate strategic decisions into clear operational actions and cross-functional coordination.
Drive commercial initiatives in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product teams.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve reporting, forecasting, and operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
Identify process gaps proactively and recommend improvements without waiting to be asked.
Requirements
Knowledge and Experience
Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, or a similar business-facing role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce, including dashboards, reports, pipeline management, and data quality.
Strong analytical skills with proven ability to build reports, track KPIs, and translate data into business insights.
Experience working with or supporting global sales teams or senior commercial leadership.
Full professional proficiency in English, including daily written and verbal interaction with global stakeholders.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, reporting, or operational workflows.
Advantages
Experience in SaaS, enterprise software, fintech, or another complex B2B technology environment.
Experience supporting QBR processes, forecasting cycles, or executive business reviews.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Experience with sales enablement, onboarding coordination, or process adoption programs.
Additional languages beyond English.
Skills
Highly analytical with strong attention to detail and a natural ability to connect data to business outcomes.
Proactive and self-driven, someone who identifies problems and acts on them without being prompted.
Strong commercial mindset and genuine interest in how sales organizations operate and grow.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, global environment.
AI-driven approach to work, with a genuine interest in using modern tools to work smarter and faster.
Eager to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

SysAid.description:
Description
This is a senior marketing leadership role with real breadth. You'll own SysAid's market narrative, brand identity, and the full content engine behind it, leading a team of seven across product marketing, content, creative, design, communications, partner marketing, and field marketing.
The right person has lived at the intersection of PMM and brand long enough to have opinions about how they should work together. They lead by creating clarity. They think in systems. And they're genuinely curious about what AI means for how a marketing team operates, not as a trend to follow, but as infrastructure to build on purpose.
About the role
You'll own how SysAid shows up in the market. That means the messaging that lands in a sales conversation, the brand identity on a campaign, the content that earns category authority over time, and the story that reaches analysts, press, and partners. All of it runs through you.
Your team covers a lot of ground: product marketing, content, creative, design, communications, partner marketing, and field marketing. That's a diverse set of disciplines, each with its own cadence and craft. The leadership challenge here isn't managing up; it's creating the conditions for seven specialists to pull in the same direction, at the same pace, without losing coherence.
You'll report to the CMO and sit at the table with Growth, Sales, and Product. You're expected to show up with a point of view on the message, on the market, on what we should be saying, and what we should stop saying.
The person we're looking for has probably led a repositioning. Has built a messaging framework that held up under pressure from Sales and Product. Has grown people who went on to lead their own functions. And is already thinking about how AI changes what a content team can produce, and what it takes to make that output trustworthy.
One thing worth knowing: this team owns the content infrastructure that feeds SysAid's AI-powered marketing engine. In a world where AI generates content at scale, the quality of the inputs determines the quality of everything downstream. That's not a technical problem; it's a leadership and editorial one. And it sits with you.
What you'll do
Own SysAid's messaging framework, which is the single source of truth for how the company talks about what it does and why it matters.
Build and maintain persona-level, product-level, and industry-level positioning that holds up in the field, including in a sales conversation, an analyst briefing, a paid campaign, or a press interview.
Translate product releases, market shifts, and competitive moves into messaging updates that reach every function fast.
Own SysAid's brand identity: visual standards, tone of voice, brand book, asset templates, and 10x our creative output.
Own the communications and PR strategy, specifically how SysAid shows up in press, analyst relations, and industry conversations.
Activate these narratives across every channel, in collaboration with Growth, to drive pipeline and brand awareness.
Grow and nurture your team, empowering them to achieve their targets and career goals.
Operationalize AI across every key content, creative, and GTM process.
Requirements
10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with direct ownership of both product marketing and brand. Exposure to both is not the same thing.
Proven track record building messaging from scratch — frameworks that held up when they hit Sales, Product, and the market simultaneously.
Experience leading and growing diverse marketing teams. Your reports develop under you. That's a pattern, not a coincidence.
A track record in cross-functional GTM: launches, repositioning exercises, or category-defining moments you can walk through in detail.
AI-native mindset. Not someone who has just tried the tools, but someone who has thought through what AI means for how a content team should be structured, what the inputs need to look like, and how to keep quality high at volume.
Comfortable at the strategic layer when the picture is still forming. Precise and execution-focused when it's time to ship.
Empathic by default, but not soft. You lead by creating clarity — for your team, for your peers, for the exec team.
A robust sense of humor:)
Why SysAid
SysAid sits at the intersection of two things the market hasn't figured out how to combine yet: enterprise-grade ITSM with agentic AI that actually does the work.
Most IT platforms added a chatbot and called it AI. SysAid's AI resolves incidents, fulfills requests, triggers workflows, and deploys automations on its own: no code, no developer, no black box. Every action is logged, traceable, and tied to rules the IT team sets. That's not a product feature. That's a different category. And the market is still catching up to what that means.
The company is at an inflection point. The product is winning. The pipeline is growing. And the marketing team is mid-way through building the operating system to match, which is a structured execution model where AI handles content production at scale, and humans own direction, quality, and judgment. It's in motion, not finished. The person stepping into this role will shape how it comes together.
That's the opportunity. A market position that's genuinely differentiated. A product that does what it says. An infrastructure that's being built with intention. And a team of seven waiting for a leader who can raise the standard across all of it.
If you want to own the narrative for a company at this moment, not after the story is written, but while it's being written, this is it.
SysAid.title: Director of Product Marketing & Brand

SysAid.description:
Description
SysAid is becoming an agentic ITSM leader - and we're rebuilding R&D to match. In our AI-native model, a managed, always-on "Machine" produces most of the code while small pods of engineers, PMs and designers direct, review, and govern it. In that world, quality isn't a phase - it's how the system is built. We're hiring a Quality Lead to own that. Why this role is different: you won't run a traditional QA team that tests features at the end. You'll own the quality gates inside the Machine and in production, author the monitoring skills our pods rely on, and hold independent authority to fail the Machine's output. Quality is our north star, and this role sets the bar.
THE MISSION: Make reliability, performance, and user experience a property of the system — not of individual heroics. Build and lead a Quality function (~9 people) that keeps an AI-native delivery org fast and trustworthy, and give the business confidence that what the Machine ships is safe to ship.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
﻿ Own quality gates in the Machine — prose-driven tests (generated from requirements, not the code), adversarial / agent-checks-agent review, static analysis and code-quality remediation (e.g. SonarCloud), and CI gates that run before anything reaches a human.
Own quality in production — release verification, production testing, and ownership of change-fail and deployment-rework rates.
Author monitoring guidelines & reusable observability skills that delivery pods and the Machine consume — so monitoring is built in, not bolted on.
Own the evals that score the Machine's output for behavioral consistency and reliability — treating evaluation as a first-class engineering discipline.
Act as an independent governance voice — with the authority to block or fail output that doesn't meet the bar, partnering closely with Architecture.
Partner with the Core Platform team on the quality of customer-issue fixes and existing functionality.
Lead, coach and grow the team — quality/gate engineers, an agent-evaluation engineer, production-monitoring (SRE) and QA-infrastructure engineers.
Set the quality metrics and report them — DORA + deployment-rework rate, escaped-defect rate, review-queue depth, eval pass rates.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN (OUTCOMES)
Fewer regressions and less firefighting; faster resolution of customer issues.
Reliability, performance and UX that customers can count on.
A quality system trustworthy enough to let autonomous delivery scale safely.
Requirements
7+ years in software quality / QA engineering, including leading a team, ideally owning quality for a SaaS product at scale.
Deep hands-on experience with test automation, CI/CD, and quality gates;
comfort with code-quality tooling (SonarQube/SonarCloud or similar).
Strong production monitoring / observability background (Datadog or
equivalent) and SRE-adjacent practices; monitoring-as-code a plus.
Fluency with engineering metrics — DORA, change-fail / rework rate, defect
escape — and using them to drive decisions.
Comfortable with AI-assisted / agentic development and evaluating LLM/agent
output (evals) — or a strong, demonstrated eagerness to go deep here.
A player-coach: credible hands-on and able to build and grow a team.
Able to hold an independent line and manage stakeholders across Engineering
and Product.
Professional English; based in (or able to work from) our Ukraine delivery center.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with agentic coding tools and orchestration.
LLM evaluation frameworks and prompt/skill versioning.
ITSM domain experience.
WHY JOIN
An unusually broad, high-impact mandate: own quality across the Machine,
production, and monitoring — with real authority.
Shape the quality function of an AI-native R&D org from a strong technical base —and set standards that govern every build at fleet scale.
We build the way we sell: our own R&D is the proof case for agentic ITSM.
SysAid.title: Quality Lead - AI-Native R&D

Description
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead complex product challenges from discovery to delivery, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build exceptional enterprise experiences. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep UX expertise, strong product thinking, and modern AI-powered ways of building products.
At SysAid, we're building AI-first enterprise software used by thousands of IT teams worldwide. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead complex product challenges from discovery to delivery, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build exceptional enterprise experiences.
What You'll Do
Own the end-to-end design quality within one or more product pods, small cross-functional teams of Product, Design, and Engineering focused on solving customer problems together.
Lead UX research, discovery, and problem framing.
Design complex workflows and user experiences from concept to production.
Drive excellence across UX research, interaction design, and overall user experience.
Work in AI-first, code-first product development workflows.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape product direction and delivery.
Improve design processes, tools, and team workflows.
Requirements
5+ years of Product Design experience, including at least 3 years designing complex B2B or enterprise products.
Experience designing AI-first products or AI-powered experiences.
Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
Excellent UX, interaction, and visual design skills with strong attention to detail.
Hands-on experience with modern AI tools as part of the design process.
A builder mindset with high ownership, pragmatism, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity.
Fluent English.
Nice to Have
Comfortable working with codebases, repositories, and frontend technologies.
Hands-on experience with AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar.
Experience with analytics or experimentation platforms such as Mixpanel.
Experience designing products for IT professionals or other complex technical domains.
