The Role
Wayve is developing driver-out Robotaxi systems that bring together the AI Driver, vehicle platform, sensors and compute, safety mechanisms, Remote Assistance, fleet services, and cloud operations.
We are looking for a Systems Engineer, Robotaxi to turn defined parts of this system-level vision into clear, implementable architecture. You will work closely alongside Wayve's lead Robotaxi System Architect, translating their reference architecture into functions, requirements, interfaces, decisions, and verification-ready outputs for the areas you own..
Your scope covers how the Robotaxi system works as a safe, scalable driver-out service — the vehicle, ADS, onboard compute, offboard capabilities, and the boundaries between Wayve, OEMs, Tier1s, and Robotaxi partners — and includes working directly with those partners to define architecture and product boundaries together, including leading technical discussions with them.
Key Responsibilities
Own the systems engineering for defined parts of the Robotaxi architecture — for example vehicle/ADS interfaces, Remote Assistance/offboard boundaries, or fleet/cloud integration
Translate use cases, operational concepts, and constraints into system requirements, interfaces, assumptions, and verification-ready specifications for the areas you own.
Work directly with OEM, Tier1, and Robotaxi operator partners to define system and product boundaries together, including leading technical working sessions and design discussions with them.
Apply the Robotaxi reference architecture to real vehicle programs across sensors, compute, ECU topology, vehicle interfaces, and degraded-operation behavior.
Support implementation through technical reviews, bring-up planning, issue triage, and design-change impact analysis.
Escalate cross-domain or cross-program trade-offs that go beyond your defined scope to the lead Robotaxi System Architect and relevant domain owners.
About You
You are a hands-on Robotaxi systems engineer who has worked on a real Robotaxi or production-intent L4 driver-out system. You can reason across hardware, embedded software, autonomy, safety, vehicle integration, offboard services, and operations, while producing engineering artifacts that teams can implement and verify.
You are comfortable owning a defined technical scope within a larger reference architecture, working in close partnership with a lead architect, and collaborating across domain boundaries. You can engage external partners directly — defining system and product boundaries together and running technical discussions — while staying clear on internal ownership.
Essential
Direct, hands-on experience designing, integrating, or deploying a Robotaxi or production-intent L4 driver-out autonomous system.
Systems engineering experience spanning several parts of the system, such as vehicle platform, sensors, compute, embedded software, ADS, safety mechanisms, Remote Assistance/offboard services, fleet/cloud systems, or operations.
Experience converting use cases and operational concepts into functional decomposition, system requirements, interfaces, assumptions, trade studies, and verification intent.
Experience defining system and product boundaries across multiple companies or organizations, such as an autonomy developer, OEM, Tier1, operator, or technology partner.
Practical vehicle or robotic-system integration experience, including architecture reviews, bring-up, issue triage, debugging, or design-change impact analysis.
Working knowledge of driver-out safety concepts, including redundancy, degraded operation, Minimum Risk Manoeuvre, fail-operational behavior, functional safety, SOTIF, and safety-case evidence.
Ability to communicate complex system designs cuments, diagrams, requirements, and technical reviews.
Desirable
Robotaxi launch readiness, fleet operations, Remote Assistance, teleoperation interfaces, depot operations, rider/passenger systems, or operational monitoring.
Production automotive E/E architecture, CAN, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, AUTOSAR, DDS, QNX, Linux, diagnostics, time synchronization, or data logging.
Sensor and compute architecture involving cameras, radar, LiDAR, IMU/GNSS, calibration, timestamping, primary/secondary compute, or redundancy.
Requirements and architecture tooling such as Jama, MBSE/SysML, interface-control documents, decision records, and traceability systems.
Experience applying one reference architecture across more than one vehicle platform, OEM, or deployment model.
Familiarity with AI/ML-based driving systems and the implications of model capability, generalization, compute headroom, and evidence for product architecture.

The role
As a Technical Program Manager for Robotaxi at Wayve, you'll own the programs that bring our robotaxi service to life - from vehicle and fleet readiness to on-the-ground launch and scaling in market. Based in Yokohama, you'll work across autonomy, vehicle software, hardware, operations, safety, and local partners to turn Wayve's AI Driver into a safe, reliable robotaxi service - keeping complex, multi-team, cross-geography delivery predictable in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. You'll often bridge Wayve's global R&D with local delivery in Japan. As the only TPM on the ground in Japan, this is a generalist role: alongside robotaxi delivery, you'll help support local vehicle programs across hardware and software as needed.
Your impact will be measured by your ability to deliver programs, drive efficiency, manage risk, and align execution with business goals. A successful TPM is a force multiplier - helping teams move faster, more effectively, and with purpose.
Key responsibilities:
Drive program delivery: Own the lifecycle of robotaxi programs - from vehicle and fleet readiness to launch and in-market scaling - improving delivery through structured execution and coordination.
Manage dependencies & risk: Track and manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs across autonomy, vehicle, operations, and safety - and escalate early with clear options.
Coordinate across functions & geographies: Keep engineering, fleet operations, safety, and local partner teams aligned - bridging Wayve's global R&D with local delivery in Japan.
Support launch & operations on the ground: Provide hands-on program support for robotaxi launch and in-market operations, on the ground in Yokohama.
Support local vehicle programs: As the only TPM in Japan, flex to support local vehicle hardware and software programs as needed.
Run delivery rhythms: Run planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retros that keep multi-team delivery predictable and reliable.
Keep stakeholders aligned: Communicate progress and risk to engineers, partners, and senior leaders, tailoring updates to each audience.
Champion continuous improvement: Improve tooling, processes, and ways of working, and share patterns across the TPM org
About you
In order to set you up for success as a Technical Program Manager for Robotaxi at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.
Essential
Bias for action: 5+ years leading complex, multi-team programs (or a strong record at this level). You lead high-complexity work across teams and get things done.
Technically strong across software and hardware: Credible with engineers across autonomy, vehicle software, and vehicle hardware; you reason about how the AI Driver runs as a robotaxi service on real vehicles - and can support vehicle hardware / software programs too - even though you won't write production code.
Stays neutral and adapts under pressure: Effective in ambiguous, safety-critical environments; you flex your style and bring structure without slowing delivery.
Strong project management: Skilled at planning, prioritising, and managing risk and dependencies across teams.
Exceptional communicator & collaborator: Operating from a remote office, you keep distributed teams aligned across time zones - communicating with clarity, proactively and in writing - and influence without authority across all stakeholders.
Cross-cultural & on the ground: Comfortable working across geographies and cultures, and hands-on with vehicles and operations in Japan; Japanese language skills a plus.
Generalist range: As the only TPM in-country, comfortable flexing beyond robotaxi to support vehicle hardware and software programs; happy wearing multiple hats.
Data-driven: Comfortable defining and using metrics to steer delivery and decisions.
Growth mindset: Open to feedback and always looking to improve.
Systems thinking: You reason about how the parts of a complex system fit together, and how a change in one area ripples into others.
Product-minded: You focus on outcomes and the people your programs serve - prioritising by impact and defining what good looks like, not just tracking activity.
Desirable
Robotaxi / AV operations, fleet, mobility, ride-hailing, or automotive experience; experience launching or scaling a service in market.
Exposure to ML, autonomy, or other compute-heavy / safety-critical domains; experience working across global and local teams. Japanese language skills and/or based in (or willing to relocate to) Yokohama / Tokyo.
An engineering or computer science degree, or experience working as an engineer.
This is a full-time role based in our office in Yokohama / Tokyo, Japan. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds, so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, with time spent working from home.

As Wayve grows across continents, we're seeking a Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer to take ownership of our Israel site’s infrastructure and network operations. Our central networking team in London
IT support engineers in the US, UK and Japan
Global cloud infrastructure teams

While the role is primarily centred on infrastructure and networking, it will also involve light hands-on IT support for the Herzliya office as the local team grows.
You’ll thrive here if you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, and helping scale systems to support AI development and autonomous vehicle testing around the world.
Network Operations & Site Infrastructure
Design, deploy, and maintain wired and wireless networks, VPNs, VLANs, and firewall policies at the Israel site.
Serve as local owner of networking and infrastructure—resolving outages, optimizing performance, and supporting new deployments.
Provide local operational support for the Israel site, helping extend global infrastructure standards and acting as the first point of contact for site-level infrastructure needs.
Work hand-in-hand with London-based network engineers to uphold configuration consistency, observability, and security.

Act as the first line of engineering-level support for infra and networking queries raised by on-site and remote teams.
Collaborate with cloud infrastructure teams to ensure seamless hybrid connectivity between on-prem and cloud environments.
Build trusted relationships with local teams by being approachable, communicative, and focused on resolving issues quickly and effectively.
Engage with technical and non-technical teams alike, ensuring clear communication and empathy in every interaction.
Act as a bridge between local site needs and global infrastructure goals, contributing to a consistent, scalable technical footprint.

Contribute to documentation, scripts, and internal tooling to make infra operations repeatable and reliable.
Security & Standards

Ensure local networking and infrastructure follow global security and compliance standards.
Scalability & Growth
Contribute to the global expansion of Wayve’s infrastructure footprint, providing input on new sites, vendor engagement, and site readiness.
Support high-bandwidth environments for data offload and development workflows used by AI and autonomy teams.

Scripting ability in Bash and/or Python for automation and tooling.
Experience operating in hybrid on-prem and cloud environments; Azure experience is a plus.

Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).

Enjoys puzzle-solving and building efficient, scalable systems.
Takes initiative and operates independently in a high-trust, low-oversight environment.
Able to manage and prioritize tasks across stakeholders and sites.

Comfortable working across time zones and cultures, especially global collaboration.
Clear communicator who can document and explain technical concepts to engineers and non-engineers alike.

Whistle.description:
About the Role:
Our client is a pioneer in AI-powered voice technology and a dominant voice provider in Media & Entertainment. They partner with major global studios, streaming platforms, and media networks to break language barriers at scale, with our production-grade voice AI already powering content live across the world's largest platforms.
They are entering their next chapter of hyper-growth: expanding into real-time voice agents, enterprise APIs, and live multilingual broadcasting. They are looking for a hands-on, strategic, and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to join their team in their Tel Aviv offices. Working directly under the VP of Marketing, you will own GTM execution end-to-end, translate cutting-edge AI capabilities into high-converting messaging, and directly drive business growth.
What You'll be Doing:
Go-To-Market & AI Positioning: Research user needs, the competitive landscape, and market trends to shape positioning and GTM strategy for new AI initiatives.
Content, SEO & AEO Strategy: Lead comprehensive content initiatives, including blogs, case studies, newsletters, and website updates, optimized for standard search engines as well as AI Answer Engines (AEO).
Funnel Activation & Optimization: Analyze customer journey data and behavioral insights to remove friction and improve conversion rates across all stages of the buyer journey.
Integrated Marketing Campaigns: Design, build, and run multi-channel campaigns that build brand awareness, generate pipeline, and capture qualified leads.
Sales Enablement & Support: Create high-impact sales assets, including pitch decks, solution one-pagers, product demos, and feature leave-behinds, to arm sales teams for enterprise deals.
Product Launch Management: Support core product and feature releases with clear, cohesive messaging that bridges complex AI architecture with real commercial value.
Agency & Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with creative, PR, and performance agencies to ensure deliverable quality and brand alignment.
Growth Identification: Proactively identify untapped growth opportunities, craft business cases, and execute experiments to test new acquisition channels.
What Were Looking For:
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on product marketing experience within B2B SaaS, AI, deep-tech, or media technology environments.
Technical Communication: Proven ability to unpack complex technology into compelling, value-driven positioning for enterprise executives. Experience with AI models, enterprise APIs, real-time audio systems would be beneficial.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Track record of close collaboration with Sales, Product, and external growth/creative agencies.
Analytical Mindset: Data-driven approach to testing content, tracking conversion funnels, and tying marketing activities to sales pipeline.
Location & Working Hours: Ability to work full-time on-site from offices at Tel Aviv-Yafo, aligned with EU/UK business hours.
You are welcome to have a look at our website for more information about Whistle: https://www.whistle.ltd/

The role covers the full delivery lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, validation, UAT, implementation, and user adoption. AI tools are used to accelerate the work, while the Business Analyst remains accountable for business logic, accuracy, and the quality of information presented to decision-makers. WHAT YOU’LL DO? Lead interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs with business stakeholders. Map business processes, identify pain points, and define practical future-state solutions. Translate business needs into requirements, KPIs, business rules, data definitions, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Define and validate the expected behavior of AI and natural-language analytics solutions, including limitations and escalation conditions. Develop and execute evaluation scenarios to identify inaccurate or misleading AI-generated answers before release. Use SQL to investigate data, validate assumptions, reconcile discrepancies, and confirm reported figures. Review data models, source-to-target mappings, data lineage, and granularity to ensure reliable results. Support access, privacy, security, and data-governance requirements for analytics and AI solutions. Collaborate with developers, data engineers, QA, and BI developers throughout the delivery lifecycle. Lead UAT, coordinate business approval, and support rollout, training, and user adoption. WHAT YOU’LL NEED? 3+ years of practical experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Systems Analyst , preferably working on Data, BI, or enterprise-system projects. Strong hands-on SQL skills , including joins, aggregations, and window functions. Proven experience in requirements gathering , leading requirements sessions, and translating business needs into clear and actionable deliverables. Good understanding of data models, source systems, data lineage, granularity, and data-quality gaps . Working knowledge of BI concepts , including dimensional modelling, measures, dimensions, and KPI definition. Experience using AI tools , with the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs. Experience working in an Agile environment , using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar backlog-management tools. Excellent written and spoken English and Hebrew . Strong analytical and structured thinking , attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and commitment to data accuracy. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills , with the ability to work across multiple business domains and constructively challenge assumptions. Responsible, diligent, independent, and service-oriented. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Apps, or Power Automate – an advantage. Experience with LLM evaluation, prompt design, RAG, or agentic systems – an advantage. Experience in maritime, logistics, or another operational industry – an advantage. * Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Job Summary
The Revenue Accounting & Reporting Manager is responsible for managing complex revenue accounting activities, ensuring compliance with revenue accounting standards (i.e., ASC 606), and delivering accurate and timely revenue reporting. This role also oversees backlog reporting and deferred revenue accounting, including warranty obligations, FOB destination terms, and military contract deferrals. The position partners with cross-functional teams to analyze revenue trends, review contracts for proper accounting treatment, and support audits. The Revenue Accounting & Reporting Manager has deep technical accounting expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct people management responsibilities.
Essential Functions
Perform and review revenue accounting in accordance with ASC 606 and company policies
Analyze complex contracts and determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment
Partner with Sales, FP&A, Legal, and Operations to review contracts and assess revenue implications
Provide guidance on revenue recognition for new products, pricing models, and business initiatives
Account for and monitor deferred revenue balances, including service contracts, FOB destination terms, and other contract deferrals
Ensure proper recognition of revenue upon satisfaction of performance obligations
Prepare detailed reconciliations and reporting for deferred revenue accounts
Support internal and external audits related to revenue, backlog, and deferred revenue
Maintain SOX compliance and strengthen internal controls over revenue processes
Preform quarterly audit of Sales Journal and Revenue Accounts to ensure compliance
Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, and revenue-related schedules
Deliver accurate and timely revenue reporting for internal stakeholders and external filings
Prepare Global Price/Volume Analysis quarterly
Maintain and report backlog data, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Provide insights into backlog trends and implications for future revenue recognition
Collaborate with FP&A and Sales to support forecasting and planning based on backlog metrics
Account for and monitor deferred revenue balances, including service contracts, FOB destination terms, and military contract deferrals
Ensure proper recognition of revenue upon satisfaction of performance obligations
Prepare detailed reconciliations and reporting for deferred revenue accounts
Identify opportunities to streamline revenue, backlog, and deferred revenue processes and enhance automation
Contribute to system implementations and upgrades related to revenue recognition and backlog tracking
Engage with IT Application team to confirm and ensure proper revenue recognition when system upgrades are performed
Required/Preferred Education and Experience
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance
10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 5 years in revenue accounting
Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Preferred
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong knowledge of ASC 606 and US GAAP
Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) and revenue/backlog reporting tools
Excellent analytical and communication skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
Experience in a global organization with multi-currency transactions
Familiarity with SaaS or subscription-based revenue models
Advanced Excel and data analysis skills

Senior UX Designer at Walmart Global Tech Israel
﻿
About us:
Walmart Global Tech’s presence in Israel has grown over the past few years with 4 acquisitions to date, all develop using industry leading technologies.
We are seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Senior UX Designer to join our Tel Aviv UX team.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in User Experience (UX/UI) and understanding or User Research (UXR) , combined with strong UI and creative design skills , a deep understanding of research- and data-driven product goals , and the ability to take ownership of end-to-end UX processes .
This role requires a designer who can work in a structured and methodical way —defining problems clearly, grounding decisions in user research and data , and translating insights into clear, intuitive user flows and high-quality experiences , while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead Core Product UX Design: Take full ownership of the user experience for Walmart Israel's digital products, shaping the design vision and transforming complex requirements into intuitive, highly functional digital solutions.
End-to-End Execution: Map comprehensive user journeys and structural workflows, seamlessly translating them into interactive prototypes and pixel-perfect, high-fidelity UI designs.
Research & Data-Driven Iteration: Conduct targeted user research (e.g., usability testing, user interviews) and leverage behavioral analytics to validate design hypotheses, pinpoint friction areas, and continuously optimize the product.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central design advocate, partnering closely with Product Managers and Engineers to balance user insights with technical feasibility and overarching business goals.
Requirements
UX Strategy, Research & Data
﻿Research & Synthesis Expertise: Demonstrated ability to conduct foundational and evaluative research (interviews, surveys) and distill findings into actionable artifacts like personas and Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD).
Methodological Fluency: Deep understanding of Human-Centered Design principles, Double Diamond frameworks, and Information Architecture modeling.
Analytical Acumen: Strong capability to interpret behavioral data, A/B test results, and funnel metrics to ground design hypotheses in empirical evidence.
Design Execution & Collaboration
Craft & Tooling Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Figma and Adobe CS, backed by a portfolio showcasing scalable design systems and meticulous attention to UI detail.
Collaborative Mindset: Proven track record of thriving in agile, cross-functional environments alongside technical and commercial teams.
Persuasive Communication: Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently defend design choices to leadership using structured rationale and data.
Nice to Have – AI Mindset:
Interest in how AI is shaping user experience and product design
Ability to integrate AI thinking into discovery, ideation, and UX flows
Awareness of user trust, transparency, and limitations in AI-driven experiences
Experience designing AI-driven or data-informed experiences is a plus
Additional Requirements:
Strong English communication skills
Hebrew – required

This is a rare hybrid role: we need a high-level strategic thinker who is equally thrilled to roll up their sleeves, dive into the raw data, and build complex models from scratch (100% hands-on). Description
eToro is the trading and investing platform that empowers users to invest, share, and learn. We were founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest simply and transparently. We have created an investment platform that is built around collaboration and investor education. On our platform, users can view other investors’ portfolios and statistics, and interact with them to exchange ideas, discuss strategies, and benefit from shared knowledge. We have 40 million registered users from 75 countries, and our platform is available in 20 languages. eToro is an innovative, fast-growing business and is listed on Nasdaq in May 2025. We have over 1,500 employees across more than 10 offices around the globe, strategically positioned to serve the needs of users. You can find out more about eToro here .
eToro is on the hunt for a Business Development Associate who is a people person, customer-centric, and ready to transform newcomers into trading experts faster than you can say "stock market".

Identify customer needs and provide tailored solutions that meet their requirements.

Handle inquiries & verification of accounts, sharing our products and services, providing prompt and professional responses to customer questions and building strong customer relationships over the phone.
Maintain accurate customer records in the CRM system, ensuring all interactions are documented.
Achieve or exceed individual and team daily, weekly, and monthly targets to meet all KPIs set out in Service Quality Standards and Balanced Scorecard.

Candidates with no experience are welcome to apply.
Fluent in both written and spoken Chinese/ English. Candidates will use Chinese/ English to write and speak to clients.
Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
Ability to handle high call volumes while maintaining quality and professionalism.
Goal-oriented mindset with the ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a customer-first mindset.
Highly motivated and sales-driven individual who is also an excellent team player.
Proficient in Microsoft Office.

Description
In 2024, eToro acquired Spaceship, strengthening eToro's presence in the Australian market and expanding into the superannuation and long-term savings sector. eToro has created an intuitive Social Trading platform that gives traders and investors access to global stock markets, with over 40 million users worldwide across 75+ countries. This brings exciting opportunities for integration and growth across the region. At Spaceship, we're on a mission to transform the way people think about and invest their money. Since 2017, we've grown to more than 200,000 members and surpassed $1.9 billion in funds under management.
We offer three core products:
Spaceship Super – a superannuation fund designed for members who want a simpler, more transparent approach to retirement savings
Spaceship Voyager – managed investment portfolios tailored to different investing timeframes and risk appetites
Spaceship US Investing – a self-directed brokerage platform for members wanting direct access to US markets
We’re an AI-first company. That means AI isn’t an add-on – it’s built into how we work, how we build, and how we support our customers. We’re looking for people who share our belief that AI, used thoughtfully, makes financial services faster, smarter, and more human.
What will you be doing?
For a fintech business built on trust, our Customer Support team is essential. You'll be the frontline of that trust – the person members turn to when they have questions, the voice that solves problems, and the ear that captures insights for the broader business.
You'll join a dedicated CX team supporting members across all Spaceship products. Your day-to-day responsibilities include:
Handling member enquiries via email, chat, and phone – answering questions about account features, product functionality, account management, and transactional issues
Solving account-specific problems – assisting with deposits, withdrawals, account updates, identity verification, and other operational queries
Managing complaints and feedback – handling complaints professionally and compassionately, escalating appropriately to compliance and management
Providing informed support – drawing on product knowledge, internal systems, and escalation pathways to give members accurate, timely answers
Supporting product and operational improvements – connecting member feedback with the business to drive insights and iterations
Maintaining compliance standards – ensuring all communications align with financial services regulations, ASIC guidance, and Spaceship's policies
Embracing AI tools – using AI-powered support tools to resolve customer enquiries faster, improve response quality, and free up time for complex, high-value interactions
You'll have access to internal tools that enable you to support members effectively and escalate complex issues to the right teams.
Requirements
Essential Requirements
2+ years in B2C customer support, customer success, or customer-facing roles in a professional services or financial services environment
Experience with customer support platforms (CRM, ticketing systems, live chat, phone systems)
Solid understanding of financial products and services – superannuation, managed investments, and/or trading platforms are a plus
Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly in writing and verbally
Strong attention to detail and compliance awareness
AI-curious – you’re excited about how AI is changing customer support and want to be at the forefront of that shift, not just along for the ride
Full working rights in Australia
You'll thrive if you are:
Curious and thorough – you dig into problems, ask good questions, and follow through until they're resolved
Empathetic and patient – you understand that members come from different backgrounds with different levels of financial literacy, and you meet them where they are
Proactive and resourceful – you don't wait to be told what to do; you identify gaps and bring solutions
A clear communicator – you can explain complex processes in plain language without being condescending
Collaborative – you work well with a small, distributed team and escalate effectively to other departments
Committed to continuous learning – fintech and financial services move fast; you stay curious and adapt
Detail-oriented with strong systems thinking – you spot errors and understand how changes in one area affect others
Nice to have (we can help you develop):
RG146 accreditation or willingness to obtain it – we'll support the right candidate
Experience in fintech, banking, or investment platforms
Experience managing sensitive or emotionally charged interactions (complaints, disputes, member distress)
Familiarity with superannuation regulations or ASIC guidance
Perks and benefits
Competitive salary
Flexibility – 2 days per week working from home
Health and wellness benefits
Professional development opportunities including financial services training and accreditations
Exposure to product development – your feedback directly influences how we buil

As a now-public company, the scope and visibility of this role are substantial, and you will have real opportunity to grow your impact alongside the business.
﻿Key Responsibilities
You’ll play a key role in supporting eToro’s regulated US entities, combining hands-on accounting with regulatory reporting, controls, automation and digital asset operations.
Own key elements of the month-end close , including journal entries, reconciliations, variance analysis, forecasting and management reporting.
Ensure financial reporting remains compliant with US GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements.
Support regulatory reporting across our US entities, including FOCUS reports, NMLS call reports, DFS reporting and transaction-level reporting for MSB and Virtual Currency operations.
Partner with the US Controller and global Finance teams on intercompany reconciliations, cash postings, prepaid expenses, fixed assets and accounting adjustments.
Support our evolving crypto and digital asset operations , including custody processes and digital asset accounting requirements.
Manage core Accounts Payable activities, including vendors, invoices, purchase orders, wires and corporate spend platforms such as Brex and Expensify.
Support financial, regulatory and tax audits, ensuring requests are accurate, complete and delivered on time.
Own client and vendor tax reporting requirements, including W-9, W-8 and 1099 reporting , working alongside external tax advisors.
Identify control gaps and build stronger, scalable processes that improve accuracy and audit readiness.
Use automation and AI-enabled tools to streamline finance workflows, reduce manual work and accelerate the month-end close.
Take ownership of ad hoc projects and evolving priorities across multiple regulated US entities.
Requirements
3+ years of accounting experience , ideally combining public accounting with industry experience.
Experience within a broker-dealer, fintech, financial services or regulated environment is strongly preferred.
Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
CPA preferred ; Series 27 or 28 would be a strong advantage.
Experience working with ERP and finance systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks or Priority .
Strong understanding of financial controls, reconciliations and month-end close processes.
A track record of automating, simplifying or improving finance processes rather than simply maintaining them.
Comfortable managing multiple priorities and collaborating with colleagues across different teams and time zones.
Strong communication skills and the confidence to take ownership.
Curiosity about crypto, blockchain and digital assets , and an interest in how the financial landscape is evolving.
What we offer:
Salary range for this role is $85,000 - $100,000 per annum
Comprehensive benefits package
Cell phone stipend
Daily lunch allowance
Gym stipend
6% 401K match
100% insurance coverage for the employee
Additional leave / recharge days
eToro trading credits
﻿Our Hiring Philosophy:
At eToro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.
That starts with how we hire . Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.
We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI . Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to eToro’s continued AI build-out.
For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI .

Write low-overhead, high-performance instrumentation using eBPF and Go
Tackle hard problems in Linux internals, networking, and protocol parsing
Push the boundaries of what can be observed without modifying customer code
Ensure the sensor runs reliably across a huge variety of kernels, distros, and Kubernetes setups
Collaborate with backend, infrastructure, and product teams to ship features end to end
Requirements
5+ years of systems or backend engineering experience, with strong Go skills
Solid grounding in operating system internals or low-level programming (C/C++/Rust, kernel, syscalls, memory management)
Deep understanding of Linux networking, syscalls, and process/container isolation
Familiarity with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, containers, CRI/CNI)
A performance mindset- you think about cache lines, allocations, and tail latency
Care about clean, maintainable, well-architected code
Love working on developer-first products and want your work to have real impact
Bonus Points
Hands-on experience with eBPF or other kernel instrumentation frameworks
Background in protocol parsing, packet processing, or network observability
Contributions to open-source systems or infrastructure projects
Why groundcover?

You'll have real ownership over your work.
We care about the craft, not just the speed.

vetric.description:
Description
What is Vetric?
Vetric builds large-scale public data infrastructure.
We provide data pipelines that collect, structure, and deliver high-volume public web data for mission-critical companies operating in cybersecurity, public safety and digital risk protection.
Our systems power platforms that detect bad actors, uncover impersonation and fraud, identify coordinated manipulation, and help public safety organizations respond faster to real-world risks.
We don’t build dashboards, and we don’t sell surface-level insights.
We build stable, production-grade data flows that become part of our customers’ core products, with the real impact of saving lives or huge known organizations from bad actors.
Operating globally, we serve industry leaders across more than 20 countries who rely on us for scale, reliability, and depth.
﻿
Why Vetric?
Vetric is profitable from day one (fully bootstrapped - we haven’t raised external funding), and we’re building foundational technology - not chasing trends. Because this is infrastructure that matters, we operate with engineering discipline, strong ownership, and long-term thinking.
We’re at a true inflection point: the team is now large enough to require real infrastructure, yet still small enough that what you build will define how things work for the next several years.
This is infrastructure that matters and so is how we operate internally. You’ll be working with a sharp, focused team that takes engineering discipline seriously and is intentionally building an organization that matches the quality of its product.
Position Overview
We’re looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with Vetric’s existing customers and become a trusted partner in their long-term success.
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for a portfolio of strategic accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding how our customers use Vetric’s data infrastructure, and identifying opportunities to deepen and expand our partnerships. You’ll combine strong relationship management with a commercial mindset - ensuring customers see continued value while driving retention, renewals, and account growth.
This role is ideal for someone who is proactive, customer-oriented, and commercially driven, with the ability to build trust, uncover opportunities, and navigate relationships across both business and technical stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
Own and manage a portfolio of existing customers, serving as their primary commercial point of contact throughout the relationship.
Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, needs, and strategic priorities.
Drive customer retention and renewals by proactively managing account health, identifying risks, and ensuring customers continue to see strong value from Vetric.
Identify and execute expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Develop account plans and growth strategies for key customers, identifying new use cases, teams, and opportunities to expand the partnership.
Lead commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and contract expansions.
Work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and other internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and address customer needs.
Maintain accurate account information, opportunities, forecasts, and activities in the CRM.
Consistently meet or exceed retention, renewal, and expansion targets and KPIs.
Requirements
3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success with commercial ownership, or a similar customer-facing role within a SaaS company.
Proven experience managing and growing mid-size and enterprise accounts.
Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated experience in renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion.
Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into meaningful business opportunities.
Highly proactive and organized, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently.
Experience with CRM platforms and account management tools.
Fluent English, with native-level proficiency preferred.
We’d be lucky if you had:
Experience working with data infrastructure, APIs, cybersecurity, public safety, or digital risk protection solutions.
Experience managing global enterprise customers, particularly in the US market.
Experience working with technical stakeholders and complex, mission-critical products.
B.A. degree in a relevant field.
We hire people, not just skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this role is a great fit for you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements.

vetric.description:
Description
What is Vetric?
Vetric builds large-scale public data infrastructure.
We provide data pipelines that collect, structure, and deliver high-volume public web data for mission-critical companies operating in cybersecurity, public safety and digital risk protection.
Our systems power platforms that detect bad actors, uncover impersonation and fraud, identify coordinated manipulation, and help public safety organizations respond faster to real-world risks.
We don’t build dashboards, and we don’t sell surface-level insights.
We build stable, production-grade data flows that become part of our customers’ core products, with the real impact of saving lives or huge known organizations from bad actors.
Operating globally, we serve industry leaders across more than 20 countries who rely on us for scale, reliability, and depth.
﻿Why Vetric?
Vetric is profitable from day 1 (fully bootstrapped - means we didn’t raise any money), a fast-growing company building foundational technology - not chasing trends.
Because this is infrastructure that matters, it requires engineering discipline, ownership, and long-term thinking.
As part of our broader R&D expansion, we’re building Kraków into a key engineering hub that will own core systems and drive our next phase of innovation and growth.
﻿ The Role & The Challenge
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer, at the mid or senior level, to join our infrastructure team, reporting directly to our DevOps Team Leader. Depending on experience, this role will either contribute to or help drive advanced infrastructure initiatives — from system design through production hardening — as we raise the bar for operational excellence across the company.
The immediate challenge: Vetric operates a high-volume, multi-account AWS environment. You will help solve complex delivery, scaling, and operational problems along the way. Scope and ownership will be calibrated to your experience level.
Responsibilities
Contribute to Cloud & Migration Strategy: Work alongside our DevOps Team Leader to help plan and execute our migration from ECS Fargate to Kubernetes (EKS) without downtime, while maintaining our existing cloud estate.
Advance Infrastructure as Code: Design and implement modern, modular IaC frameworks utilizing Terraform and OpenTofu to ensure consistent, multi-environment deployments.
Improve Enterprise CI/CD: Evolve our delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions, OIDC federation) at scale, reducing developer friction and elevating deployment safety across dozens of services.
Support Data-Intensive Infrastructure: Help maintain the performance, capacity, and resilience of our high-volume data layer (ClickHouse, ScyllaDB, DynamoDB, RDS, Redis) and event-driven messaging pipelines.
Strengthen Reliability & Observability: Help maintain organization-wide reliability standards using open, modern telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry, Coralogix, Grafana), ensuring on-call operations are driven by signal, not noise.
Balance Growth & Governance: Participate in technical tradeoff decisions that balance velocity, least-privilege security, zero-trust access (Tailscale), and FinOps cost efficiency.
Requirements
3+ years of hands-on DevOps, Infrastructure, or Cloud Engineering experience, with real production exposure in high-throughput, data-intensive environments.
Cloud Expertise: Solid working knowledge of AWS architectures, including compute, networking (VPC, DNS, segmentation), IAM, and scalability patterns.
Kubernetes Experience: Hands-on experience running and/or optimizing Kubernetes clusters (EKS) in production.
IaC & Automation Proficiency: Strong experience with Terraform and solid scripting/software engineering skills in Python, Go, or TypeScript, plus confident Bash.
Container & Pipeline Ownership: Familiarity with container workloads (ECS/Docker) and modern CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions) using safe rollout strategies.
Observability: Experience designing and/or operating observability and alerting stacks (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs).
Collaborative Communication: Pragmatic, clear communicator who thrives in a high-velocity, autonomous team environment and builds trust through sound technical judgment.
Note: We're hiring across mid to senior levels for this role. The depth of your experience across the above areas will determine the scope and seniority of the position offered.
Beneficial Experience
Direct experience leading an ECS-to-Kubernetes migration in a production environment.
Deep knowledge of EKS ecosystem tooling (Karpenter, ArgoCD/Flux, KEDA, VPC CNI).
Experience operating analytical or wide-column databases at scale (ClickHouse, ScyllaDB).

vi.description:
About The Position
Vi is the market-leading Enterprise-AI platform for health, serving some of the world’s largest health organizations—from Fortune 500 healthcare providers to pharma and consumer brands—helping them maximize acquisition, enrollment, engagement, retention, and health outcomes. Vi’s platform is backed by $125M+ in R&D, serving over 175 million members daily and growing.
We operate across New York, Austin, Nashville, and Tel Aviv and are looking for a talented Business Analyst to join our team.
We are looking for a talented Data Analyst that will play a crucial part of the product team, leading the continuous growth and improvement of the most important product that powers Vi’s success. As a Business analyst, you will ensure that our data and insights are actionable to drive decisions across the business and communicate data-driven insights and recommendations to key stakeholders at all levels. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical, and analytical sense and can communicate meaningful, actionable insights in a clear and concise manner.
Responsibilities
Be the focal point in terms of data familiarity, business goals and KPIs in a data-centric company
Help promote a “data-driven culture” with all stakeholders, both internally and externally.
Proactively perform data analysis that yields recommendations for improving our models, and campaigns and also surface new opportunities.
Attend customer-facing meetings and convey data insights in a clear and informative manner
See beyond numbers and help to inform, influence, support and execute our business decisions
Build reports, dashboards and metrics, in addition to monitoring the integrity and validity of the data reported
Be a trusted partner for executive management to ensure program success.
Conduct user segmentation/churn prediction/funnel optimization and LTV analysis by manipulating Vi’s data sets.
Build ROI models
Provide essential visibility of our data to multiple stakeholders: Product Managers, Commercial team, and Engineering by developing and maintaining meaningful and actionable dashboards.
Identify Medical/Clinical gaps in Vi offering when approaching specific markets and recommend methods to address them (white papers, publications, etc’).
Requirements
3+ years of experience in making analytical, data-driven decisions and communicating the results to key stakeholders – preferably in SaaS companies
3+ years of experience manipulating data sets using SQL
Experience with visualization tools (preferable Tableau)
3+ years of experience working collaboratively with different stakeholders
Ability to think strategically, analyze and interpret product behavioral data to grow the business
Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hebrew
Strong data storytelling abilities
Bachelor’s Degree in a data-related field – Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, Business etc.
Advantages
A passion for technology and for learning
Knowledge in Python
Experience in data analysis and visualization using Python
Why choose VI
At Vi we provide you with the autonomy to deliver, the safety to make mistakes and the opportunity to help millions of people live happier and healthier lives.
We believe that building a great product and a great company starts with finding amazing people and helping them grow and develop professionally and personally. At Vi, you’ll be surrounded by curious, witty, and passionate people that are hungry to drive real impact.
But if that’s not enough, we also offer a competitive salary, stock plans, & loads of extra perks
